items.title: AI避風港愈來愈貴！蘋果今年漲30% 估值衝2007年來最高
items.title_en: AI Safe Haven Gets More Expensive! Apple Up 30% This Year, Valuation Highest Since 2007
paras: 據《彭博》周三(18日)報導，當投資人拋售晶片、雲端與AI基礎建設相關股票時，蘋果(AAPL-US)卻成為資金避風港，今年來累計上漲約30%，表現居科技七巨頭之首，市值達5.1兆美元，登上全球最大企業寶座。
然而，追求穩定的代價也愈來愈高。蘋果未來12個月預估本益比已達37倍，為2007年以來最高，躋身標普500估值最昂貴的25檔股票之列，讓市場開始思考：這座AI避風港，是否已經太貴？

未跟進AI軍備競賽 穩定現金流吸引資金

蘋果今年不僅領先其他科技巨頭，也是標普500上漲的最大貢獻者，占該指數今年7.5%漲幅的約28%。周三早盤，蘋果股價再上漲約0.7%。
支撐買盤的關鍵，是蘋果沒有像其他大型科技企業一樣，大舉投入AI基礎建設競賽，而是持續銷售iPhone與Mac，等待技術成熟後，讓消費者透過旗下裝置使用AI服務。
相較之下，其他科技巨頭為追逐AI商機大幅增加資本支出，自由現金流也承受壓力。蘋果較克制的投資策略，反而成為市場震盪時的優勢。
伯恩斯坦分析師Mark Newman在11月12日報告中指出，蘋果較不受AI資料中心資本支出下滑的風險衝擊，也避開大型雲端業者自由現金流急降的壓力。他認為，考量客戶忠誠度、獲利持續性、成長、現金流與股東回報，蘋果目前的估值並非高得離譜。

股價跑在目標價前 成長放緩考驗高估值

不過，蘋果仍有基本面挑戰。公司本月稍早公布的利潤率展望令人失望，並面臨記憶體等零組件供應限制。市場預期，截至明年9月的2027會計年度營收將成長10%，低於2026會計年度的15%，之後兩年增速還可能進一步放緩。
依《彭博》數據，蘋果本益成長比(PEG)已達5.3，創2005年有紀錄以來最高。這項指標以本益比除以獲利成長率，數值偏高，意味投資人正為成長支付較高價格。相較之下，輝達(NVDA-US)因本會計年度獲利預期翻倍、估值卻下滑，PEG降至不到0.15的歷史低點。
華爾街也顯露猶豫。《彭博》追蹤的59名蘋果分析師中，僅36人給予買進評等；股價更已超過分析師平均目標價，成為科技七巨頭中，唯一以平均目標價計算、未來12個月隱含報酬為負的股票。
YieldMax ETFs策略師Mike Khouw提醒，蘋果目前波動偏低，但估值相較歷史已明顯偏高，進一步擴張的空間有限，投資人必須留意部分估值溢價消退的可能。
仍將蘋果列為年度五大首選之一的Niles Investment Management創辦人Dan Niles則認為，若AI持續發展，蘋果可透過手機與電腦受惠；若AI景氣反轉，也能提供相對防禦性。不過，即使看好蘋果在目前環境下的定位，他仍坦言不喜歡現在的估值。
paras_en: According to Bloomberg on Wednesday the 18th, while investors were dumping stocks tied to chips, cloud and AI infrastructure, Apple (AAPL-US) became a safe haven, climbing about 30% so far this year, ranking first among the seven big tech giants, with a market value of $5.1 trillion, taking the top spot as the world’s largest company.

However, the price of stability is rising. Apple’s forward P/E ratio for the next 12 months has reached 37 times earnings, the highest since 2007, placing it among the 25 most expensive S&P 500 stocks and prompting the market to wonder whether this AI safe haven has become too pricey.

Apple not only leads other tech giants this year but also is the biggest contributor to the S&P 500’s rise, accounting for roughly 28% of the index’s 7.5% gain so far. On Wednesday morning Apple’s shares rose another about 0.7%.

The key to the buying pressure is that Apple, unlike other large tech firms, has not poured massive money into the AI infrastructure race, instead continuing to sell iPhones and Macs while waiting for the technology to mature so consumers can use AI services through its devices.

By contrast, other tech giants have dramatically increased capital spending to chase AI opportunities, putting pressure on free cash flow. Apple’s more restrained investment strategy has become an advantage during market turbulence.

Bernstein analyst Mark Newman noted in a November 12 report that Apple is less exposed to the risk of a slowdown in AI data‑center capex and avoids the pressure of a sharp drop in free cash flow that large cloud providers face. He believes that given customer loyalty, earnings sustainability, growth, cash flow and shareholder returns, Apple’s current valuation is not absurdly high.

Nevertheless, Apple still faces fundamental challenges. The profit‑margin outlook released earlier this month was disappointing, and the company is dealing with component supply constraints such as memory. The market expects revenue for the fiscal year ending September 2027 to grow 10%, down from 15% for fiscal 2026, with growth possibly slowing further over the following two years.

Bloomberg data show Apple’s price‑to‑earnings‑to‑growth (PEG) ratio has risen to 5.3, the highest on record since 2005. This metric, which divides the P/E by earnings growth, is elevated, indicating investors are paying a premium for growth. By comparison, Nvidia (NVDA-US) sees its PEG fall to below 0.15, a historic low, as earnings expectations double while its valuation declines.

Wall Street also shows hesitation. Among the 59 Apple analysts tracked by Bloomberg, only 36 rate the stock as a buy; the share price has already surpassed analysts’ average target price, making Apple the only one of the seven big tech stocks whose implied 12‑month return, based on average target, is negative.

YieldMax ETFs strategist Mike Khouw cautions that Apple’s volatility is currently low, but its valuation is clearly elevated relative to history, leaving limited room for further expansion and raising the risk that part of the valuation premium could erode.

Dan Niles, founder of Niles Investment Management, still lists Apple as one of his top five picks for the year, arguing that if AI continues to develop, Apple can benefit through its phones and computers, and if AI sentiment reverses, the stock offers relative defensiveness. However, even though he likes Apple’s positioning in the current environment, he admits he does not like the present valuation.

items.title: 科技股預估本益比一年暴跌42%！Truist投資長喊進：市場悲觀情緒反成反彈訊號
items.title_en: Tech Stocks Forecast Forward P/E Plummets 42% in a Year! Truist CIO Calls It a Buying Opportunity as Market Pessimism Turns Into a Rebound Signal
paras: 在科技股估值經歷歷史性下修，投資人情緒也大幅惡化之後，Truist Advisory Services投資長Keith Lerner建議，目前科技股配置低於基準的投資人，可以開始考慮提高持股比重。
Lerner坦言，人工智慧(AI)交易仍面臨風險，尤其是輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳遭撤換，加深市場對領導層、晶片出口限制、融資環境、供需狀況，以及資料中心投資前景的疑慮。
但Lerner說：「市場不會等到不確定性完全消失才採取行動。市場往往在實際結果僅僅沒有預期中那麼糟時，就開始反轉。」
科技股占比高的那斯達克100指數已落入修正區間，周二(17日)收盤和10月6日高點相比回跌14%，將近三分之二成分股更進入熊市區間。
Lerner進一步指出，過去六個月以來，科技股相對標普500指數的表現已從9月底領先25%，轉為落後6%。
根據美國銀行(BofA)調查，全球AI熱潮的投資樂觀情緒正在消退，基金經理人對科技股的配置降幅創20年來最大。
Lerner認為，科技股表現落後、投資人情緒轉趨悲觀，反而是市場即將反彈的訊號，而非預告跌勢將進一步擴大。他指出，科技股預估本益比(forward P/E)過去12個月已下跌42%，是近30年來該產業最劇烈的估值修正之一。
儘管這波跌勢可能讓人聯想到網路泡沫，但Lerner說：「如今市場的起始條件與整體背景已大不相同。2000年市場觸頂前一年，科技股估值上漲逾100%。如今，科技股估值已跌破2022年底這波多頭行情啟動時的水準。」
當然，科技股投資並非毫無風險。Lerner指出，企業財報表現不如預期、利率走高，以及AI投資周期出現更大幅度的退潮，是他對市場展望最主要的威脅。
不過，此次估值修正「異常劇烈」，意味著只要企業獲利預估下修幅度沒有市場擔憂得那麼大，科技股就可能迅速反彈。
Lerner寫道：「雜誌封面往往被視為反向指標，因為當一個故事登上頭版時，相關論述通常已廣為人知，也可以說早已反映在市場價格中。恐懼與貪婪可能迅速轉變，市場也是如此。」
paras_en: After tech stock valuations underwent a historic downgrade and investor sentiment sharply deteriorated, Keith Lerner, CIO of Truist Advisory Services, suggested that investors whose tech allocation is below the benchmark can now start considering increasing their holdings.

Lerner admitted that AI trading still faces risks, especially after Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang was ousted, deepening market concerns about leadership, chip export restrictions, financing conditions, supply‑demand dynamics, and the outlook for data‑center investments.
But Lerner said, "The market won’t wait for all uncertainty to disappear before acting. It often turns around as soon as the actual outcome is not as bad as expected."

The Nasdaq‑100, which has a high weighting of tech stocks, has slipped into correction territory, closing on Tuesday the 17th down 14% from its October 6 peak, with nearly two‑thirds of its components now in bear‑market territory.
Lerner further noted that over the past six months the relative performance of tech stocks versus the S&P 500 has shifted from leading by 25% at the end of September to lagging by 6%.
According to a Bank of America survey, the global AI hype’s investment optimism is waning, and fund managers have cut their tech stock allocations by the biggest margin in 20 years.

Lerner believes that the lagging performance of tech stocks and the turn toward pessimistic sentiment actually signal an imminent market rebound rather than a further decline. He pointed out that the forward P/E for tech stocks has fallen 42% over the past 12 months, one of the steepest valuation corrections in the industry in the last 30 years.

Although this decline may evoke memories of the dot‑com bubble, Lerner said, "The market’s starting conditions and overall backdrop are vastly different today. A year before the 2000 peak, tech valuations rose more than 100%. Now, tech valuations have fallen below the level at the start of the bullish run at the end of 2022."

Of course, investing in tech stocks is not without risk. Lerner highlighted that weaker-than‑expected earnings, rising interest rates, and a deeper pull‑back in the AI investment cycle are the main threats to his market outlook.
However, this "exceptionally sharp" valuation correction means that as long as earnings revisions are not as severe as market fears suggest, tech stocks could rebound quickly.

Lerner wrote, "Magazine covers are often seen as contrarian indicators, because when a story makes the front page, the narrative is already widely known and essentially priced in. Fear and greed can flip rapidly, and the market is no different."

items.title: SpaceX假設對OpenAI「零銷售」！馬斯克反擊奧特曼AI晶片需求遭高估言論
items.title_en: SpaceX Assumes Zero Sales to OpenAI! Musk Counters Altman's Claim That AI Chip Demand Is Overestimated
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US)執行長馬斯克透露，公司目前假設對OpenAI的銷售額為零。馬斯克發表這番言論前，OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）才針對半導體產業可能高估需求一事，進一步說明先前的看法。馬斯克與奧特曼長期以來對OpenAI的本質與發展方向存在分歧。
根據《Wccftech》報導，奧特曼日前表示，資料中心的需求與建置規模可能存在上限，未必能消化供應鏈中所有即將到貨的晶片庫存。對此，馬斯克則在社群平台X發文反擊。
稍早，奧特曼在Semafor舉辦的一場活動中，談及自己向三星(005930KS) 主管表示AI晶片需求可能遭到高估的相關言論。
AI晶片需求是目前AI產業建設熱潮的核心議題，奧特曼先前也曾討論新興雲端業者（neocloud）在需求估算中扮演的角色。
奧特曼當時向三星主管表示，市場趨勢顯示，每家新興雲端業者在估算需求時，都可能將OpenAI與Anthropic的需求納入考量，導致整體晶片需求被高估，因為這兩家大型軟體公司可能只會使用部分新興雲端業者的基礎設施。
在此基礎上，奧特曼16日進一步表示：「我認為，需求以及資料中心的建置趨勢都相當穩健。但我們並不需要、也不可能，向每一家晶片供應商採購所有的供應量。」
然而，同時掌舵SpaceX與特斯拉(TSLA-US) 的馬斯克認為，如果OpenAI的產品表現無法帶動資料中心算力需求快速成長，那麼該公司就應該檢視自身產品是否出了問題。
馬斯克寫道：「SpaceX假設對OpenAI的銷售額為零。如果OpenAI的需求沒有快速攀升，那麼他們的產品一定出了問題。」
SpaceX今年稍早在首次公開募股（IPO）相關文件中揭露，公司已成為運算基礎設施供應商，業務涵蓋地面資料中心園區，以及未來透過衛星星座在太空提供運算服務的計畫。
SpaceX之所以躋身業界最大型運算服務供應商之列，部分仰賴旗下Colossus資料中心等設施。這些資料中心已與Google(GOOGL-US) 及Anthropic達成協議，將提供運算能力。
分析指出，從馬斯克的說法來看，他相信SpaceX即使不依賴OpenAI，也能充分運用自身所有的晶片運算產能。
此外，馬斯克同樣不看好新興雲端業者，先前曾預測這類業者將面臨「孔雀魚級別的大規模死亡」（guppy-level death）。
與此同時，馬斯克旗下Colossus資料中心計畫在2026年底前，讓超過120萬顆輝達(NVDA-US) GPU投入運作，目標是打造全球規模最大的運算叢集。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk disclosed that the company currently assumes zero sales to OpenAI. Musk made this remark after OpenAI CEO Sam Altman addressed the possibility that the semiconductor industry may have overestimated demand, further explaining his earlier view. Musk and Altman have long disagreed on OpenAI's nature and development direction.

According to a report by Wccftech, Altman recently said that data‑center demand and build‑out scale may have an upper limit and might not be able to absorb all the chip inventory soon arriving in the supply chain. Musk responded to this on the social platform X.
Earlier, Altman at a Semafor‑hosted event mentioned his comments to a Samsung (005930KS) executive that AI‑chip demand could be overestimated.
AI‑chip demand is a core issue in the current AI industry construction boom, and Altman has previously discussed the role of emerging cloud providers (neocloud) in demand estimates.

Altman told the Samsung executive that market trends show each emerging cloud provider may factor OpenAI and Anthropic demand into its estimates, inflating overall chip demand because these two large software firms may only use a portion of the emerging clouds' infrastructure.
Building on that, Altman said on the 16th: "I think demand and data‑center build‑out trends are quite robust. But we don’t need, nor can we, purchase the entire supply from every chip supplier."

However, Elon Musk, who also runs Tesla (TSLA-US), believes that if OpenAI’s products fail to drive rapid growth in data‑center compute demand, the company should examine whether its products have problems.
Musk wrote: "SpaceX assumes zero sales to OpenAI. If OpenAI’s demand doesn’t surge quickly, then their product must be flawed."

Earlier this year, SpaceX disclosed in its IPO filing that it has become a provider of compute infrastructure, covering ground data‑center campuses and plans to offer compute services from a satellite constellation in space.

SpaceX’s rise to become one of the industry’s largest compute service providers is partly due to facilities such as its Colossus data centers, which have agreements with Google (GOOGL-US) and Anthropic to supply compute power.
Analysts note that from Musk’s comments, he believes SpaceX can fully utilize all its chip compute capacity even without relying on OpenAI.
Musk also remains skeptical of emerging cloud providers, having previously predicted they would face a "guppy‑level mass death."
Meanwhile, Musk’s Colossus data‑center project aims to have over 1.2 million NVIDIA (NVDA-US) GPUs operational by the end of 2026, targeting the creation of the world’s largest compute cluster.

items.title: 雲端巨頭狂發債9400億美元！惠譽警告AI發債潮恐引爆公司債市場波動
items.title_en: Cloud Giants Flood the Market with $940 Billion in Debt! Fitch Warns AI Debt Surge Could Spark Volatility in Corporate Bond Market
paras: 國際信評機構惠譽（Fitch Ratings）發布最新報告指出，隨著高評級超大規模雲端服務商（hyperscalers）大舉發債以支應龐大的AI資本支出，美國投資等級非金融公司債市場正日益集中於科技、電信及零售等少數產業。2026年截至10月底，美國相關公司債發行總額已達9400億美元、年增33%，惠譽警告產業分散度降低恐加劇市場波動。
惠譽在報告中分析，這波發債規模激增主要受惠於AI相關債務發行潮帶動，使今年前10月美國投資等級非金融公司債發行量較去年同期大幅成長33%。由於科技巨頭持續投入算力與資料中心等基礎建設，龐大的融資需求推動債市結構快速向特定產業傾斜，進而墊高了整體投資等級公司債市場的風險水準。
隨著債市集中度提高與潛在波動加劇，惠譽進一步示警，部分發債機構未來恐面臨更為緊縮的融資環境。特別是在美國公債殖利率持續維持高檔的情況下，一旦超大規模雲端業者的信用體質轉弱，或是市場對其股票估值產生疑慮，將直接引發信用利差擴大，進一步牽動整體公司債市場的定價與籌資難度。
在借貸成本居高不下的環境中，企業債務再融資的難度也隨之攀升。惠譽點名醫療保健、科技以及公用事業等近期有大量債務即將到期的產業，其面臨的營運與財務風險將會被放大。這些發債機構不僅必須承受更高的利息支出，在進行債務展延或再融資時，更需要精準抓準市場窗口伺機發債，以降低籌資衝擊。
展望後續發債動能，惠譽預期短期內龐大的AI相關債務發行仍將持續，以支撐未完成的基礎建設計畫。不過，若AI龐大資本支出的實際投資報酬率持續存在不確定性，導致機構投資人的認購需求出現起伏與觀望，未來雲端巨頭與AI相關企業的發債節奏，恐怕會從目前的熱絡轉變為較為零星的狀態。
paras_en: Fitch Ratings released a new report stating that as highly rated, ultra‑large cloud service providers (hyperscalers) issue massive amounts of debt to fund huge AI capital expenditures, the U.S. investment‑grade non‑financial corporate bond market is becoming increasingly concentrated in a few sectors such as technology, telecommunications and retail. By the end of October 2026, total issuance by these U.S. companies had reached $940 billion, up 33% year‑over‑year, and Fitch warns that the reduced industry diversification could amplify market volatility.

The report analyzes that the surge in issuance is driven primarily by the wave of AI‑related debt offerings, which has caused U.S. investment‑grade non‑financial corporate bond issuance in the first ten months of this year to jump 33% compared with the same period last year. Ongoing spending by tech giants on computing power and data‑center infrastructure creates huge financing needs, pushing the bond market’s composition sharply toward these sectors and raising the overall risk level of the investment‑grade corporate bond market.

With bond‑market concentration rising and potential volatility increasing, Fitch further cautions that some issuers may face a tighter financing environment in the future. In particular, as U.S. Treasury yields remain high, a weakening credit profile of the ultra‑large cloud players or doubts about their equity valuations could trigger widening credit spreads, affecting pricing and fundraising conditions across the corporate bond market.

In an environment of persistently high borrowing costs, refinancing corporate debt becomes more difficult. Fitch points to healthcare, technology and utilities as sectors with a large amount of debt maturing soon, whose operational and financial risks will be magnified. These issuers will not only have to bear higher interest expenses but also must time the market precisely when extending or refinancing debt to lessen the impact on fundraising.

Looking ahead, Fitch expects the massive AI‑related debt issuance to continue in the short term to support unfinished infrastructure projects. However, if the actual return on the huge AI capital outlays remains uncertain, causing institutional investors’ demand to fluctuate and become more cautious, the pace of debt issuance by cloud giants and AI‑related firms may shift from the current fervor to a more sporadic pattern.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉輝達交卷穩軍心！科技股回神 下一關看Anthropic
paras: 美股主要指數周三(18日)漲跌互現，其中標普500與那斯達克綜合指數雙雙上揚。輝達(NVDA-US)財報優於預期，並釋出強勁營收展望，緩解投資人對公司成長前景與AI投資熱潮能否延續的疑慮，帶動科技股買氣回溫。
市場同時關注Anthropic(預定股號：ANT-US)即將登場的IPO，觀察AI類股風險偏好能否進一步回升。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌近230點或近0.5%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近70點或近0.3%，標普 500 指數跌0.02%，費城半導體指數跌近0.4%，台積電ADR漲近0.5%。
輝達(NVDA-US)強勁展望緩解投資人對人工智慧(AI)交易能否延續的疑慮，帶動美股期貨走高。不過，聯準會(Fed)理事華勒呼籲考慮12月升息2碼，使早盤較大的漲幅收斂，短天期美債價格也由漲轉跌。

輝達展望穩軍心 AI投資動能仍強

輝達上調2028年營收成長目標，讓市場對公司能否在黃仁勳離職後維持成長動能，獲得部分 reassurance。財報也帶動其他遭到拋售的AI概念股反彈，雲端業者Nebius(NBIS-US)、CoreWeave(CRWV-US)盤前走揚，南韓三星電子(005930-KS)、SK海力士(SKHY-US)(000660-KS)股價同步上漲，歐洲科技股也表現突出。
道富環球市場分析師Marija Veitmane表示，輝達財報與展望再次印證其他科技公司的說法：AI資本支出強勁，幾乎沒有放緩跡象。她認為，強勁獲利搭配較低估值與投資人持倉，使科技股具備投資吸引力。
不過，市場仍關注輝達未來是否繼續大力支持整個AI產業。代理執行長克瑞斯已暗示，投資策略可能更重視紀律；董事長瓊斯排除黃仁勳回任，也使公司治理與接班方向持續受到檢視。
The Sevens Report分析師Tom Essaye指出，輝達與CoreWeave若開高後持續擴大漲幅，可能意味科技股修正接近尾聲；若兩者開高卻收黑，則顯示投資人仍趁反彈減碼AI基礎建設部位。

升息陰影壓抑漲勢 Anthropic IPO成下個考驗

華勒周三表示，通膨仍朝錯誤方向發展，呼籲Fed考慮12月升息2碼。這番鷹派言論壓抑股市期貨漲幅，並使短天期美債價格由漲轉跌。
其他資產方面，美元上漲約0.2%，布蘭特原油在每桶93美元附近震盪，銅價下跌，黃金則今年首度跌破每盎司3,800美元。
除了輝達，投資人也關注Anthropic首次公開發行(IPO)，以及川普、習近平與俄羅斯總統普丁在深圳的會談動向。
據悉，Anthropic正向潛在投資人釋出訊息，預期發行價將落在承銷區間上緣，甚至高於區間，預定周三定價。
Pepperstone策略師Dilin Wu表示，Anthropic IPO將是AI產業風險偏好的下一場考驗。若股票在高估值下仍能持續吸引買盤，可能進一步支撐整體AI類股的投資情緒。
