items.title: 黃仁勳還要赴參院作證！美商務部長也點頭 國會追查輝達風波
items.title_en: Jensen Huang to Testify Before Senate; Commerce Secretary Also Approves, Congress Probes Nvidia Controversy
paras: 據《CNBC》周三(18日)報導，美國參議院銀行委員會主席史考特(Tim Scott)證實，輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳與商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)，均已同意自願出席委員會作證。這是黃仁勳同意接受眾議院閉門訪談之外，另一項國會作證安排。
史考特接受《CNBC》節目「Squawk Box」訪問時表示：「他們兩人都已同意。我們希望能在聖誕節前完成。」參院聽證的確切日期目前尚未公布，史考特先前要求黃仁勳公開作證。
史考特表示，作證將有助委員會釐清，兩人「知道哪些事情、何時得知，以及為何沒有採取行動」。
他並將矛頭指向盧特尼克，表示相關官員早在今年3月就已被提醒，應將新加坡業者Megaspeed列入美國商務部的「實體清單」。這份名單針對美方認定涉及國安等風險的企業，實施出口限制。
史考特批評，商務部工業暨安全局(BIS)與盧特尼克均未採取這項行動，「我們想知道為什麼」。
Megaspeed曾向輝達購買晶片，美國調查人員懷疑該公司涉嫌將晶片轉流中國。黃仁勳婚外關係對象黃樂(Alice Huang)曾任該公司高階主管，並被美方懷疑涉及中國情報活動。相關爭議曝光後，黃仁勳已於上周辭去輝達執行長職務。
隨著風波擴大，盧特尼克與財政部長貝森特之間的分歧也浮上檯面。貝森特上周五接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，財政部長期支持對Megaspeed實施限制。至於商務部為何未採取行動，他表示：「你們必須詢問他們的內部程序。」
眾議院方面，黃仁勳周二已與外交委員會、對中事務特別委員會及情報委員會主席達成協議，將於12月1日接受三個委員會聯合進行的閉門訪談，並製作逐字紀錄。
黃仁勳發言人對於史考特宣布他同意赴參院作證一事，拒絕評論。
paras_en: According to CNBC on Wednesday (the 18th), U.S. Senate Banking Committee Chairman Tim Scott confirmed that Nvidia (NVDA-US) former CEO Jensen Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick have both agreed to voluntarily appear before the committee to testify. This follows Huang’s agreement to a closed-door interview with the House and represents another congressional testimony arrangement.

Scott told CNBC’s “Squawk Box” that “both of them have agreed. We hope to finish before Christmas.” The exact date for the Senate hearing has not yet been announced, and Scott had previously asked Huang to testify publicly.
Scott said the testimony would help the committee clarify what the two knew, when they knew it, and why they did not take action.

He also pointed the finger at Lutnick, noting that officials were warned as early as March this year that Singapore‑based Megaspeed should be placed on the U.S. Commerce Department’s Entity List, which restricts exports to companies deemed a national‑security risk.
Scott criticized the Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) and Lutnick for not taking that step, saying, “We want to know why.”

Megaspeed had purchased chips from Nvidia, and U.S. investigators suspect the company was diverting the chips to China. Huang’s former partner, Alice Huang, who once held a senior position at Megaspeed, is also suspected by U.S. authorities of involvement in Chinese intelligence activities. After the controversy surfaced, Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO last week.

As the scandal grew, a rift between Lutnick and Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen became public. Yellen told CNBC last Friday that the Treasury has long supported restricting Megaspeed. When asked why the Commerce Department had not acted, she said, “You have to ask them about their internal process.”

In the House, Huang reached an agreement on Tuesday with the chairs of the Foreign Affairs Committee, the Select Committee on the China Task Force, and the Intelligence Committee to undergo a joint closed‑door interview on December 1, with a verbatim transcript to be produced.
Huang’s spokesperson declined to comment on Scott’s announcement that he had agreed to appear before the Senate.

items.title: 過去一年只有「兩家」七巨頭股價跑贏標普500！「這項差異」成關鍵
items.title_en: Only Two of the Seven Tech Giants Outperformed the S&P 500 Over the Past Year! This Difference Was Key
paras: 美股科技巨頭「七巨頭」（Magnificent Seven）過去一年多數未能跑贏大盤，反映投資人對科技股的選擇日益挑剔。在人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮持續之際，Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 與蘋果(AAPL-US) 成為七巨頭中唯二績效超越標普500指數的企業，分析師認為，兩家公司採取不同於同業的AI布局策略，是股價表現相對突出的原因。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，自2025年初以來，Alphabet股價累計上漲50.8%，蘋果也上漲42%，雙雙領先同期報酬率達29%的標普500指數。
相較之下，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、Meta(META-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 、輝達(NVDA-US) 及特斯拉(TSLA-US) 股價表現均落後大盤。
晨星（Morningstar）分析師 William Kerwin 表示，市場正在「挑選AI贏家」。
他指出，Alphabet受到投資人青睞，部分原因在於旗下張量處理單元（TPU）晶片可與輝達產品競爭；此外，Alphabet旗下尖端AI模型Gemini，也具備與OpenAI及Anthropic產品競爭的實力。
蘋果則採取不同策略。Kerwin表示，儘管沒有自有AI模型，該公司仍透過合作夥伴關係導入AI技術，將其作為改善使用者體驗的工具，同時在AI研發上的支出明顯低於同業。
相較之下，Kerwin指出，微軟、亞馬遜與Meta因大舉投入AI基礎設施而受到市場懲罰。
Tandem Investment Advisors共同投資長 Ben Carew 也認為，蘋果選擇不跟進部分七巨頭企業的AI軍備競賽，是明智決定。他指出，其他科技巨頭正投入龐大資金爭奪AI市場，這些支出未必能帶來同等程度的投資回報。
MoffettNathanson分析師 Craig Moffett 則表示，蘋果的吸引力恰恰在於其股價與整體AI投資題材的連動性較低。當投資人開始擔憂主要競爭對手能否從AI基礎設施支出中獲利時，便可能轉向蘋果，將其視為相對安全的選擇。
不過，蘋果並非沒有挑戰。Moffett 認為，iPhone 18系列的市場表現遠不如去年iPhone 17系列；此外，AI代理（AI Agents）也可能繞過蘋果既有生態系統，削弱該公司對自身系統的掌控能力。
Alphabet方面，自2025年初以來，投資人對該公司的態度出現明顯轉變。Carew 指出，Alphabet部分憑藉TPU業務，成功將自身定位為AI市場的重要競爭者，甚至可能已侵蝕輝達在晶片市場的部分市占率及主導地位。
不過，蘋果與Alphabet近期股價表現已出現分歧。蘋果股價目前較上周創下的收盤高點下跌不到2%，Alphabet股價則較今年5月創下的收盤高點回落約30%。
paras_en: U.S. tech giants known as the “Magnificent Seven” largely failed to beat the market over the past year, reflecting investors’ increasingly picky selection of tech stocks. Amid the ongoing AI investment frenzy, Alphabet (GOOGL-US) and Apple (AAPL-US) were the only two of the seven whose performance surpassed the S&P 500 index, and analysts say the two companies’ AI strategies that differ from their peers explain the relative stock‑price strength.
According to MarketWatch, since the start of 2025 Alphabet’s stock has risen 50.8% and Apple’s has risen 42%, both well ahead of the S&P 500’s 29% total return over the same period.
By contrast, the shares of Amazon (AMZN-US), Meta (META-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US), Nvidia (NVDA-US) and Tesla (TSLA-US) all lagged the broader market.
Morningstar analyst William Kerwin said the market is “picking AI winners.”

He noted that Alphabet is favored in part because its Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) chips can compete with Nvidia’s products, and its cutting‑edge AI model Gemini is capable of taking on offerings from OpenAI and Anthropic.

Apple takes a different approach. Kerwin said that even without its own AI model, the company leverages partnerships to bring AI technology into its products as a tool for improving user experience, while spending far less on AI R&D than its peers.
Kerwin added that Microsoft, Amazon and Meta have been punished by the market for pouring massive money into AI infrastructure.

Ben Carew, co‑Chief Investment Officer at Tandem Investment Advisors, also believes Apple’s decision not to join the AI arms race that many of the other Magnificent Seven are engaged in was wise. He said other tech giants are committing huge sums to capture AI market share, but those expenditures may not deliver comparable returns.

MoffettNathanson analyst Craig Moffett said Apple’s appeal lies precisely in its stock’s relatively low correlation with the broader AI investment theme. When investors worry about whether major rivals can profit from AI‑infrastructure spending, they may shift to Apple as a relatively safe alternative.

However, Apple does face challenges. Moffett points out that the iPhone 18 series is performing far worse than last year’s iPhone 17 series, and AI agents could bypass Apple’s existing ecosystem, weakening the company’s control over its own systems.

On the Alphabet side, investor sentiment has shifted noticeably since early 2025. Carew said Alphabet, partly thanks to its TPU business, has positioned itself as a key AI market competitor and may already be eroding Nvidia’s market share and dominance in the chip sector.

Nevertheless, Apple’s and Alphabet’s recent stock moves have diverged. Apple’s share is down less than 2% from the closing high it set last week, while Alphabet’s stock has fallen about 30% from the closing peak it reached in May this year.

items.title: 接班困難是8成企業出售主因？亞洲富豪掀家辦熱潮 超高資產家族最怕「這件事」
items.title_en: Succession Difficulties Drive 82% of Companies to Sale? Asian Ultra‑Wealthy Spark Family Office Boom, With Ultra‑Rich Families Most Worried About This Issue
paras: 全球家族企業迎來世代交替高峰，安永與瑞士寶盛銀行發布《2026家族晴雨表》指出，高達82.2%的家族因接班困難而選擇出售企業，但企業退出後卻面臨「保存家族共同財富」的最大隱憂（占比達79.4%）。為解決守富難題並彌補65.9%二代尚未準備好接班的缺口，75.5%的亞洲超高資產家族傾向成立單一家族辦公室，掀起專業化傳承熱潮。
全球家族企業陸續迎來世代交替高峰，安永與瑞士寶盛銀行共同發布《2026家族晴雨表》報告指出，接班規劃已成為全球超高資產家族首要議題。調查顯示，高達65.9%的受訪專業人士認為，尚未規劃出售或交棒的家族中，下一代仍未做好接班準備；僅22.6%認為已就位，另有11.6%直言下一代根本無意接手，顯示家族傳承不能只停留在單純交棒。
針對接班困境，安永聯合會計師事務所稅務服務部營運長林志翔表示，面對人工智慧帶來的產業劇變，家族企業規劃傳承時必須同步思考創新轉型。若家族內部缺乏合適人選，逐步退出經營也是選項，但退場涉及情感依附與企業估值，需較長時間準備。他建議可透過閉鎖性股份有限公司作為控股平台，區分所有權與經營權並引進專業經理人，為永續傳承保留彈性。
調查進一步揭露家族企業在面對轉型與退場時的「準備度落差」，在考慮出售或移轉企業的超高資產家族中，僅有2.3%已完全做好準備，56.3%僅有部分準備。林志翔指出，許多家族只著重職位與經營權移交，卻忽略培養下一代理解股東責任。數據顯示，45.6%的家族在討論出售時雖會徵詢二代意見，卻未給予表決權，僅18.5%的下一代能以平等地位參與重大決策。
除了下一代準備程度不足，家族內部能否凝聚共識更是影響傳承進程的關鍵。報告指出，80%受訪者將「家族對出售缺乏共識」列為主要阻礙，其次為稅務考量55.4%及治理流程薄弱49.1%。當實際進入退出討論階段，「情感依附」更以60.6%成為最常見的共識落差，其次是對企業未來發展意見不一58%及估值期待落差55.3%，顯示財務條件具備不等於心理準備就緒。
當下一代無意接掌或接班困難時，出售企業成為許多家族的轉型路徑，調查顯示有82.2%的家族因接班困難而選擇完整或部分退出。然而，企業出售後並不代表傳承結束，家族課題將從經營本業轉向管理共同財富。高達79.4%的受訪專業人士認為，「保存家族共同財富」是退出後最需關注的非財務議題，其次則是協助成員釐清角色與尋找共同目標，占比達68.4%。
將焦點轉向亞洲市場，隨著第一代企業家紛紛面臨首次重大接班或資產變現，課題已從創造財富轉向跨世代守富。調查發現，高達75.5%的亞洲超高資產家族在退出企業後傾向成立單一家族辦公室，比例高居全球之冠；但亞洲二代平等參與出售後策略的比例僅8.4%，顯示亞洲家族在保留核心決策權的同時，正積極藉由家族辦公室引進專業團隊，推動財富管理制度化。
paras_en: Global family businesses are hitting a peak of generational transition. Ernst & Young and Swiss private bank Pictet released the “2026 Family Barometer,” noting that as many as 82.2% of families choose to sell their companies because of succession difficulties, yet after exiting the business the biggest concern – cited by 79.4% – is how to preserve the family’s collective wealth. To address the wealth‑preservation challenge and fill the gap that 65.9% of second‑generation members are not yet ready to take over, 75.5% of Asian ultra‑high‑net‑worth families prefer to set up a single family office, sparking a wave of professionalised succession.

Global family businesses are increasingly facing a generational‑transition peak. Ernst & Young and Pictet jointly published the “2026 Family Barometer” report, which finds succession planning has become the top issue for ultra‑high‑net‑worth families worldwide. The survey shows that 65.9% of respondents believe the next generation in families that have not yet planned a sale or hand‑over is still unprepared; only 22.6% think they are ready, while 11.6% say the next generation has no intention of taking over, indicating that family succession cannot rely solely on a simple hand‑over.

Addressing the succession dilemma, Lin Zhixiang, COO of Ernst & Young’s Tax Services, said that with the industry upheaval brought by artificial intelligence, family businesses must consider innovative transformation when planning succession. If suitable internal candidates are lacking, a gradual exit is an option, but exiting involves emotional attachment and valuation issues that require lengthy preparation. He recommends using a closed‑share company as a holding platform to separate ownership from management and bring in professional managers, preserving flexibility for sustainable succession.

The survey further reveals a “readiness gap” for family businesses facing transformation or exit. Among ultra‑high‑net‑worth families considering a sale or transfer, only 2.3% are fully prepared, while 56.3% are partially prepared. Lin notes many families focus on transferring positions and management rights but overlook cultivating the next generation’s understanding of shareholder responsibilities. Data show that 45.6% of families consult the second generation when discussing a sale but do not grant voting rights, and only 18.5% allow the next generation to participate equally in major decisions.

Beyond the next generation’s lack of readiness, internal consensus is a key factor in the succession process. The report finds 80% of respondents cite “lack of family consensus on a sale” as a major obstacle, followed by tax considerations (55.4%) and weak governance processes (49.1%). When discussions move to exit, “emotional attachment” becomes the most common consensus gap at 60.6%, followed by differing views on the company’s future (58%) and valuation expectations (55.3%), showing that financial readiness does not equal psychological preparedness.

When the next generation is unwilling or unable to take over, selling the business becomes a common transformation path. The survey shows 82.2% of families choose a full or partial exit due to succession difficulties. However, a sale does not end the succession story; the family’s focus shifts from operating the core business to managing collective wealth. A striking 79.4% of professionals say “preserving family collective wealth” is the top non‑financial issue after exit, followed by helping members clarify roles and find common goals (68.4%).

Turning to the Asian market, as first‑generation entrepreneurs face their first major succession or asset‑realisation events, the focus has shifted from wealth creation to cross‑generational wealth preservation. The survey finds that 75.5% of Asian ultra‑high‑net‑worth families prefer to establish a single family office after exiting a business—the highest proportion globally—but only 8.4% of Asian second generations participate equally in post‑sale strategy, indicating that while Asian families retain core decision‑making power, they are actively using family offices to bring in professional teams and institutionalise wealth management.

items.title: 罕見連環爆！AI鏈驚見鉅額違約交割 創意、華通等9檔合計4.27億元
items.title_en: Rare Chain Reaction! Massive Default Deliveries Hit AI Chain, 9 Stocks Including Creative and Wistron Total NT$427 Million
paras: 受輝達(NVIDIA)共同創辦人黃仁勳下台消息衝擊，全球AI產業鏈劇烈震盪，拖累台股 16 日重挫，依據「T+2」交割制度，今(18)日交割日，證交所及櫃買中心同步公告，上市櫃共計多達9檔個股爆出鉅額違約交割，合計違約總金額高達4億2,694萬6,248元，且清一色集中於AI伺服器、散熱、PCB及半導體供應鏈。
根據證交所與櫃買中心最新揭露資訊，今日共有4檔上市股、5檔上櫃股達到違約交割揭露標準。在集中市場方面，共有創意(3443-TW)、華通(2313-TW)、欣興(3037-TW)與金像電(2368-TW)等4檔上榜，合計違約金額達2億6,633萬9,246元。
其中，ASIC設計大廠創意違約金額高達9,453萬元居冠，由中信託忠、玉山景美兩家分點申報；PCB大廠華通違約金額達9,360萬3,500元居次，申報券商包括華南台南、兆豐松德、國泰館前、群益海山、國泰敦二等5家分點。
載板大廠欣興違約金額為5,204萬2,746元，申報分點多達15家，涵蓋國泰敦南、國泰敦二、華南淡水、元大莒光、永豐天母、凱基松山、永豐板盛、群益鳳山、第一彰化、國泰館前、元大松山、富邦經紀、永豐金、元大雙和與元大永寧；AI伺服器板大廠金像電則有2,616萬3,000元違約交割，由永豐敦南、永豐板盛、永豐金、國泰敦南、元大松山、國泰館前、國泰敦三、華南頭份等8家分點申報。
上櫃市場同樣災情慘重，共有雙鴻(3324-TW)、精材(3374-TW)、穩懋(3105-TW)、精測(6510-TW)與金山電(8042-TW)等5檔個股出現鉅額違約，合計金額達1億6,060萬7,002元。
上櫃部分以散熱大廠雙鴻違約6,465萬6,000元最多，由企銀埔墘、華南南京、台新台中3家分點申報；台積電概念股精材違約4,001萬0,902元，申報分點為合庫高雄、國泰敦二、元大基隆、永豐敦南、永豐金、台新大裕等6家。
砷化鎵大廠穩懋違約3,406萬2,500元，申報券商高達12家分點，包含第一彰化、國票博愛、國泰新莊、國泰敦二、國泰敦三、群益海山、凱基永康、元大基隆、永豐金、永豐台中、永豐亞灣與永豐桃園。此外，測試介面廠精測違約1,186萬元(玉山景美申報)，被動元件廠金山電則違約1,001萬7,600元(中信託忠申報)。
市場人士分析，從今日申報券商分點分布來看，不僅出現中信託忠、玉山景美等單一分點同時跨足多檔高價股與AI股的鉅額違約，欣興與穩懋更分別湧現15家與12家券商分點同步申報的罕見現象，反映在突發利空導致股價急殺下，無論是主力大戶或短線當沖客，均面臨龐大的資金周轉與交割壓力。
提醒投資人，近期國際科技產業訊息變化快速，操作高波動個股及從事當日沖銷交易時，務必審慎評估自身財力與風險承受能力，並隨時確認交割帳戶資金是否充足，以免發生違約交割，進而影響個人信用紀錄甚至承擔相關法律責任。
paras_en: The resignation of NVIDIA co‑founder Jensen Huang sent shockwaves through the global AI supply chain, dragging Taiwan stocks down sharply on the 16th. Under the T+2 settlement system, today (the 18th) the Taiwan Stock Exchange and the OTC market announced that a total of nine listed and OTC stocks suffered massive default settlements, amounting to NT$4,269,466,248, all concentrated in AI servers, cooling, PCB and semiconductor supply chains.

According to the latest disclosures from the TWSE and the OTC market, four listed stocks and five OTC stocks met the default settlement reporting threshold today. In the main market, Creative (3443‑TW), Wistron (2313‑TW), Unimicron (3037‑TW) and Goldensun (2368‑TW) were listed, with a combined default amount of NT$2,663,390,246.

Among them, ASIC designer Creative led with a default of NT$94,530,000, reported by two branches of CTBC Trust and E.SUN Jingmei; PCB giant Wistron posted a default of NT$93,603,500, reported by five broker branches: Hua Nan Tainan, Mega Songde, Cathay Guandian, KGI Haishan and Cathay Dun‑II.

Unimicron’s default was NT$52,042,746, reported by as many as 15 branches, including Cathay Dun‑South, Cathay Dun‑II, Hua Nan Tamsui, Yuanta Juguang, SinoPac Tianmu, KGI Songshan, SinoPac Ban‑Sheng, KGI Fengshan, First Changhua, Cathay Guandian, Yuanta Songshan, Fubon Brokerage, SinoPac, Yuanta Shuanghe and Yuanta Yongning. AI‑server maker Goldensun defaulted NT$26,163,000, reported by eight branches: SinoPac Dun‑South, SinoPac Ban‑Sheng, SinoPac, Cathay Dun‑South, Yuanta Songshan, Cathay Guandian, Cathay Dun‑III and Hua Nan Toufen.

The OTC market suffered similarly severe fallout, with five stocks—Shuang Hong (3324‑TW), Jingcai (3374‑TW), Wenmao (3105‑TW), Jingce (6510‑TW) and Jinshan Electronics (8042‑TW)—recording massive defaults totaling NT$1,606,070,002.

In the OTC segment, cooling‑equipment maker Shuang Hong had the largest default at NT$64,656,000, reported by three branches: Qiyin Pujian, Hua Nan Nanjing and Taishin Taichung. TSMC‑related stock Jingcai defaulted NT$40,010,902, reported by six branches: Heku Kaohsiung, Cathay Dun‑II, Yuanta Keelung, SinoPac Dun‑South, SinoPac and Taishin Dayu.

Gallium‑arsenide specialist Wenmao defaulted NT$34,062,500, reported by a dozen branches including First Changhua, Guopiao Boai, Cathay Xinzhuang, Cathay Dun‑II, Cathay Dun‑III, KGI Haishan, KGI Yongkang, Yuanta Keelung, SinoPac, SinoPac Taichung, SinoPac Yawan and SinoPac Taoyuan. Test‑interface firm Jingce defaulted NT$11,860,000 (reported by E.SUN Jingmei) and passive component maker Jinshan Electronics defaulted NT$10,017,600 (reported by CTBC Trust).

Market analysts note that today’s broker‑branch filings show not only single branches like CTBC Trust and E.SUN Jingmei simultaneously defaulting on multiple high‑price and AI stocks, but also rare cases where 15 branches reported Creative and 12 branches reported Wenmao at the same time. This reflects the severe cash‑flow and settlement pressure on both major investors and short‑term traders after the sudden negative news drove prices sharply lower.

Investors are reminded that international tech news is changing rapidly. When trading highly volatile stocks or engaging in day‑trading, they should carefully assess their financial capacity and risk tolerance, and continuously verify that settlement accounts have sufficient funds to avoid default deliveries that could damage personal credit records and incur legal liabilities.

items.title: 優群伺服器、電信訂單逐步放量 明年營運拚雙位數成長
items.title_en: Yugong's Server and Telecom Orders Gradually Increase, Targeting Double-Digit Growth Next Year
paras: 連接器廠優群(3217-TW)今(18)日召開法說會，總經理劉興義表示，受筆電市場需求疲弱、記憶體缺料及價格上漲影響，今年營運承壓，不過隨著伺服器及電信相關產品逐步放量，明年營運可望重返成長軌道，目標營收年增雙位數，獲利也將挑戰今年水準。
劉興義指出，今年筆電市場受到記憶體缺料及價格上漲影響，部分機種改採On-board形式出貨，降低SO-DIMM連接器需求，加上終端銷售下滑，使SO-DIMM及M.2產品營收均受到衝擊。不過，公司觀察，客戶長期仍偏好採用記憶體模組形式，隨著供應鏈逐步改善，On-board應屬過渡性做法。
展望明年，劉興義指出，成長動能主要來自伺服器及電信客戶，並非預期筆電市場復甦，因此公司對NB相關產品仍採較保守的估算。Server方面，Google相關專案已於11月進行首次試產，預計明年第一季量產，且客戶希望由越南廠生產，將有助於營收成長及越南廠稼動率提升。
此外，優群也積極布局高階伺服器記憶體應用，包括SO CAMM，目前已與客戶進行試產及送樣，並有機會取得雲端伺服器客戶的Vendor Code，若順利導入量產，將帶來進一步的營收貢獻。
電信訂單則自第三季起陸續進入量產，第四季及明年出貨可望延續成長，預估明年電信營收占比將由今年約5%提升至10%，占比倍增。整體產品應用結構也將有所調整，筆電占比預計由今年約65%降至明年約50%，桌機及伺服器合計占比則可望由今年約14%提升至20%，降低對單一應用市場的依賴。
新產品方面，CAMM第三季出貨較前季大幅成長，單月出貨量高點已接近10萬個，低點則約5萬個。原先預期明年第一、二季逐步擴大導入的HP機種，目前量產時程未變，但實際出貨數量仍須視客戶取得記憶體模組的情況而定。優群也預期，隨著Lenovo及HP高階機種陸續導入，CAMM明年可望逐步挹注營收。
越南廠方面，優群已開始規劃微型沖壓件於當地生產，明年也將陸續導入DDR Long DIMM及微型沖壓件，提供客戶第二生產基地。劉興義表示，越南廠目前產值仍相對有限，但隨著新產品及訂單移入，明年稼動率可望改善，並開始看到損益兩平的跡象。
劉興義表示，今年營收估將呈現年減，毛利率也可能進一步下滑；明年營收目標則希望達雙位數成長，隨著營收及產能利用率回升，毛利率也可望優於今年。若明年毛利率能維持今年下半年的水準，全年獲利將有機會挑戰今年表現。
paras_en: Yugong (3217-TW) held a financial briefing today (18th) where General Manager Liu Xingyi noted that the weak laptop market demand, memory shortages, and price hikes have pressured this year's operations. However, as server and telecom products gradually ramp up, the company expects operations to return to growth next year, targeting double-digit revenue growth and challenging last year's profitability.

Liu highlighted that this year's laptop market was affected by memory shortages and price increases, leading some models to switch to on-board configurations, reducing demand for SO-DIMM connectors. Coupled with declining end‑user sales, revenues from SO-DIMM and M.2 products were impacted. Nevertheless, the company observes that customers still prefer memory module formats long term, and on‑board is a transitional approach as the supply chain improves.

Looking ahead to next year, Liu said growth will mainly come from server and telecom customers, not from a laptop market rebound, so the company remains conservative on notebook products. In the server segment, a Google‑related project had its first pilot production in November, with mass production expected in Q1 next year. Customers also prefer production in Vietnam, which will help revenue growth and improve the Vietnam plant’s utilization.

Yugong is also actively developing high‑end server memory applications, including SO‑CAMM. Trials and sample deliveries are underway with customers, and there is a chance to secure a vendor code from cloud server clients. Successful mass production would further contribute to revenue.

Telecom orders began entering mass production from Q3, with Q4 and next year expected to continue growing. Telecom revenue is projected to rise from about 5% this year to 10% next year, doubling its share. The overall product mix will shift: laptop share is expected to drop from about 65% this year to 50% next year, while desktop and server combined share should rise from about 14% to 20%, reducing reliance on a single market.

Regarding new products, CAMM shipments in Q3 grew sharply compared to the previous quarter, with monthly highs near 100,000 units and lows around 50,000. The HP models initially planned for phased introduction in Q1 and Q2 next year remain on schedule, but actual shipments depend on customers securing memory modules. Yugong expects that as Lenovo and HP high‑end models roll out, CAMM will gradually contribute to revenue next year.

In Vietnam, Yugong has begun planning micro‑stamping components for local production and will gradually introduce DDR Long DIMM and micro‑stamping parts next year, providing a second production base for customers. Liu noted that the Vietnam plant’s output is still limited, but with new products and orders moving in, next year’s utilization should improve, showing signs of breakeven.

Liu stated that this year’s revenue is expected to decline, with gross margin potentially falling further. Next year’s revenue target is double‑digit growth, and as revenue and capacity utilization rebound, gross margin should exceed this year’s. If next year’s gross margin maintains the level of the second half of this year, annual profit could challenge last year’s performance.

items.title: 黃仁勳回鍋無望？營收亮眼難抵換帥衝擊！野村看台股有戲：4大族群將「倒吃甘藨」
items.title_en: Is Jensen Huang’s Return Unlikely? Bright Revenue Can’t Offset Leadership Turmoil! Nomura Sees Play in Taiwan Stocks: Four Sectors Set to Benefit
paras: 全球AI晶片龍頭輝達（NVDA-US）公布第3季財報，單季營收達1158億美元、年增103%，但市場焦點全鎖定執行長黃仁勳請辭與回鍋風波。儘管黃仁勳表態樂意回歸，輝達董事長瓊斯已明確拒絕並啟動新任執行長遴選。野村投信指出，人事與政策變數雖引發AI類股修正，但AI基建屬於遞延而非取消，台灣的四大族群供應鏈有望「倒吃甘蔗」。
針對輝達高層人事異動，黃仁勳雖對外釋出若符合各方利益願重返崗位的訊息，但董事長瓊斯在法說會上強調，黃仁勳為主動請辭且董事會已一致接受，無意讓他回任執行長，目前正透過獵頭公司物色接班人選。與此同時，美國商務部工業暨安全局也發布最新出口管制規定，嚴格限制先進晶片與伺服器的遠端存取。
美國商務部此次新規旨在防堵受限制對象透過第三國資料中心取得高階算力，市場預期這將提高全球AI供應鏈的合規成本與交付變數。另一方面，知名AI模型Claude開發商Anthropic預計於美國時間19日正式掛牌上市，其首度公開募股的定價水準與掛牌後股價表現，將成為檢視全球資金對AI高估值接受度的重要風向球。
主動野村台灣50（00985A-TW）基金經理人林浩詳分析，輝達亮眼財報反映強勁硬體需求，Anthropic掛牌則有助觀察市場對AI商業化變現的信心，後續仍須追蹤終端營收能否支撐龐大的算力資本支出。雖然美國民主黨選後對資料中心監管態度引發基建放緩疑慮，但短期信心衝擊並不等於實質需求反轉，投資人應回歸合約交付本質評估。
根據外資法人最新預估，2027年全球在建的AI資料中心專案將維持原有進度，僅部分位於德州與俄亥俄州尚未開工的專案，可能由原先規劃的2028年遞延至2029年完工。林浩詳認為，專案時程延後意味著需求與營收認列時間點向後推移，並非訂單取消，只要未來供電、審批與資金條件陸續到位，台灣AI供應鏈營運仍可望倒吃甘蔗。
進一步評估輝達換帥對供應鏈的實質影響，林浩詳表示關鍵在於雙方的合約條款細節，即便合約設有最低付款或取消補償機制，相關廠商仍須留意實際交貨與貨款回收時程可能出現遞延。因此在台股選股策略上，核心重點在於檢視企業訂單能否實質轉化為帳面獲利與穩定現金流，避免盲目追逐缺乏基本面支撐的題材股。
在具體看好的產業族群方面，林浩詳建議投資人持續關注同時服務繪圖處理器與客製化晶片客戶的先進製程與先進封裝業者，以及直接受惠於新世代AI伺服器機櫃規格升級的組裝廠、散熱解決方案與高階電源供應器企業。這些具備高技術門檻與戰略價值的關鍵零組件廠，將在AI基礎建設逐步落實的過程中展現較強的獲利韌性。
面對AI產業消息面雜音頻傳與股價劇烈波動，主動式ETF展現靈活調整的操盤優勢。林浩詳指出，主動式團隊能依據最新訂單能見度、獲利展望與評價面變化動態調整持股權重，在精準掌握具成長支撐標地的同時，迅速降低基本面轉弱個股的曝險。建議投資人依自身風險承受度採取定期定額策略，紀律參與台灣AI供應鏈的長線成長紅利。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US), the global leader in AI chips, reported Q3 revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year‑over‑year, but market focus is locked on CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation and potential return saga. Although Huang has said he is willing to come back, Nvidia chair Jensen Jones has outright rejected it and launched a search for a new CEO. Nomura Asset Management notes that while personnel and policy variables have prompted a correction in AI stocks, AI infrastructure is delayed rather than cancelled, and Taiwan’s four major supply‑chain groups are expected to "eat the sugarcane from the bottom up."

Despite Huang’s public signal that he would return if it served all parties’ interests, Jones emphasized at the earnings call that Huang resigned voluntarily and the board has unanimously accepted it, with no intention of reinstating him as CEO. The board is now working with a headhunter to find a successor. Meanwhile, the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security has issued new export‑control rules that tightly restrict remote access to advanced chips and servers.

The new U.S. rules aim to block restricted entities from obtaining high‑performance compute through third‑country data centers, and the market expects this will raise compliance costs and delivery uncertainties across the global AI supply chain. On the other hand, Anthropic, the developer of the Claude AI model, plans to go public on the U.S. market on the 19th, and its IPO pricing and post‑listing performance will serve as a key barometer of global investors’ appetite for high‑valued AI stocks.

Active‑managed Nomura Taiwan 50 (00985A‑TW) fund manager Lin Hao explained that Nvidia’s stellar earnings reflect strong hardware demand, while Anthropic’s listing helps gauge market confidence in AI commercialization. The next step is to monitor whether end‑customer revenue can sustain massive compute‑capex. Although post‑election Democratic scrutiny of data‑center regulation raises concerns of infrastructure slowdown, short‑term confidence hits do not equal a fundamental demand reversal; investors should return to evaluating the substance of contract deliveries.

According to the latest foreign‑institutional forecasts, AI data‑center projects under construction worldwide will stay on schedule through 2027, with only a few Texas and Ohio projects that have not yet broken ground possibly pushed from 2028 to 2029. Lin Hao notes that delayed project timelines shift demand and revenue recognition later, but do not cancel orders; as long as power, approvals and financing materialize, Taiwan’s AI supply chain can still "eat the sugarcane from the bottom up."

Assessing the real impact of a leadership change at Nvidia on the supply chain, Lin Hao says the key lies in contract terms. Even if contracts contain minimum‑payment or cancellation‑compensation clauses, suppliers must watch for possible delays in actual delivery and cash collection. Thus, Taiwan‑stock selection should focus on whether orders can translate into real earnings and stable cash flow, avoiding blind chases of hype‑driven stocks lacking fundamentals.

For the sectors he favors, Lin Hao recommends investors keep an eye on advanced‑process and advanced‑packaging firms that serve both graphics processors and custom‑chip customers, as well as assemblers, cooling‑solution providers and high‑end power‑supply companies that will directly benefit from next‑generation AI server‑rack upgrades. These high‑tech, strategically valuable component makers are expected to show strong profit resilience as AI infrastructure rolls out.

Amid the noisy AI news flow and volatile stock moves, active ETFs demonstrate flexible trading advantages. Lin Hao points out that active teams can adjust holdings dynamically based on the latest order visibility, earnings outlook and valuation shifts, capturing growth‑supporting targets while quickly reducing exposure to weakening fundamentals. He advises investors to adopt a regular‑investment plan suited to their risk tolerance to systematically capture the long‑term growth dividend of Taiwan’s AI supply chain.

items.title: 安勤工業、醫療及零售三大動能接力 明年營運估雙位數成長
items.title_en: Anjie Industrial's Three Growth Engines in Industrial, Medical, and Retail Sectors Drive Double-Digit Operating Growth Next Year
paras: 工業電腦廠安勤(3479-TW)今(18)日召開法說，展望2027年，總經理張嘉哲表示，明年營運目標維持雙位數成長，年增率至少達10%，主要成長動能來自工業、醫療及零售三大應用，其中工業領域受惠半導體設備伺服器等新專案逐步放量，成長動能最強。
張嘉哲表示，今年營運可望創歷史新高，全年維持雙位數成長；展望明年，工業應用將是主要成長引擎，今年前三季工業業務已年增約15%，全年預期維持1至2成成長，隨著國際智慧裝置龍頭客戶專案逐步交貨，以及半導體設備、伺服器相關訂單挹注，明年成長動能可望延續。
其中，半導體設備領域已取得大型客戶專案，產品為應用於設備的1U伺服器，單價每台超過2萬美元，後續還有機會爭取同一客戶其他應用訂單。日本停車場管理系統專案則採用輝達Jetson平台，預計最快今年第四季、最晚明年第一季量產出貨，規模達數千台，產品單價也高於一般產品。
零售方面，今年前三季業務年增約20%至22%，全年預期維持相近成長幅度。明年主要成長動能來自日本大型連鎖超商平板換機訂單，數量超過3萬台，預計2027年9月開始出貨。此外，日本連鎖超商餐飲系統訂單已開始準備出貨，印度ATM專案也已少量出貨，每批約500台，預期明年進一步放量。
醫療方面，既有心導管系統目前年出貨量約6,000台，後續預期維持相近規模，訂單能見度至少延續數年，新一代心導管系統則已進入開發階段，預計2028年接軌。明年也將推進數個新專案，包括採用NVIDIA高階運算平台、搭配雙攝影鏡頭的病患監控系統，其他醫療客戶的新產品也陸續進入量產階段。
除三大應用外，安勤也看好明年軍工業務的成長機會，主要受惠部分原由美超微(Supermicro)服務的客戶及市場出現轉單機會，目前已有客戶接洽並進行產品驗證，涵蓋工業、醫療、軍工等特殊應用客製化伺服器，以及L6白牌伺服器市場。隨著AI與IPC應用界線逐漸模糊，地端AI及大型語言模型需求也可望帶動相關商機。
在美國在地生產方面，安勤已確認與加州外包廠合作，負責SMT打件及板卡生產，經過約一年測試後，已確認合作廠商的品質與製造能力；系統組裝則已與美國廠商談妥，未來可利用其印第安納州廠區承接少量多樣訂單，尤其有利於軍工客戶對PCBA及相關產品的在地製造需求。
至於毛利率表現，安勤表示，受到記憶體等零組件漲價、低毛利代採購業務增加，以及與客戶在採購價格調整機制上仍處於磨合階段等因素影響，毛利率承壓，後續還得等到記憶體等關鍵零組件價格回落，有機會改善。
paras_en: Industrial computer maker Anjie (3479‑TW) held its earnings briefing today (18th). Looking ahead to 2027, General Manager Zhang Jia‑zhe said the operating target for next year remains double‑digit growth, with an annual increase of at least 10%. The main growth drivers will come from industrial, medical and retail applications, with the industrial segment benefiting most from new semiconductor‑equipment and server projects that are gradually scaling up, providing the strongest momentum.

Zhang said this year’s operations are expected to hit a historic high, maintaining double‑digit growth for the full year. Looking to next year, industrial applications will be the primary growth engine; industrial sales have already risen about 15% year‑over‑year in the first three quarters, and full‑year growth of 10‑20% is expected. As flagship international smart‑device customers begin delivering projects and semiconductor‑equipment and server orders flow in, the growth momentum is likely to continue into next year.

In the semiconductor‑equipment sector, a large‑customer project has been secured for 1U servers used in equipment, priced at over US$20,000 each, with further opportunities to win additional orders from the same customer. A Japanese parking‑lot management system project uses NVIDIA Jetson platforms and is slated for mass production shipment as early as Q4 this year or at the latest Q1 next year, with a scale of several thousand units and a unit price higher than standard products.

In retail, sales in the first three quarters grew about 20‑22% year‑over‑year, and a similar growth rate is expected for the full year. Next year’s main driver will be a tablet replacement order from a large Japanese convenience‑store chain, exceeding 30,000 units, scheduled to ship starting September 2027. Orders for the chain’s dining‑system have also begun shipping preparation, and a small‑scale Indian ATM project has shipped about 500 units per batch, with further scaling expected next year.

In medical, the existing cardiac catheter system ships roughly 6,000 units annually and is expected to stay at a similar level, with order visibility extending for several years. A next‑generation cardiac catheter system is now in development and slated for launch in 2028. Next year will also see several new projects, including a patient‑monitoring system that uses NVIDIA high‑performance computing platforms and dual cameras, while other medical customers are moving new products into mass production.

Beyond the three core applications, Anjie sees growth opportunities in the defense sector next year, benefiting from customers and markets previously served by U.S. Supermicro that are now re‑routing orders. Customer engagements and product validation are already underway for customized servers for industrial, medical and defense applications, as well as the L6 white‑label server market. As the line between AI and IPC blurs, demand for edge AI and large language models is expected to generate related business.

Regarding U.S. local production, Anjie has confirmed a partnership with a California subcontractor for SMT assembly and board manufacturing. After about a year of testing, the partner’s quality and manufacturing capability have been validated. System integration has been arranged with a U.S. partner, which will use its Indiana facility to handle low‑volume, high‑mix orders—particularly advantageous for defense customers needing local PCBA and related product manufacturing.

On gross‑margin performance, Anjie said margins are under pressure due to price hikes in memory and other components, an increase in low‑margin procurement services, and ongoing adjustments with customers on pricing mechanisms. Margin recovery will depend on the decline of key component prices such as memory, which could improve the situation later.

items.title: 川習會前示警！台海進入關鍵24個月 美報告揭中國封鎖台灣風險
items.title_en: Trump‑Xi Meeting Pre‑Warns: Taiwan Strait Enters Critical 24‑Month Window, US Report Highlights China’s Blockade Risk
paras: 據《巴隆周刊》周三(18日)報導，美中經濟暨安全檢討委員會(USCC)在年度報告中警告，未來24個月將是觀察北京對台策略的關鍵時期。若中國認為透過政治影響與施壓推動統一的策略失效，可能轉向對台實施海上隔離或封鎖。委員會呼籲美國與盟友預先擬定應變計畫。
報告發布之際，美國總統川普正在深圳，準備與中國國家主席習近平會面，雙方試圖維持脆弱的休兵局面。不過，委員會指出，台海、中國AI模型擴張，以及北京對全球商品市場與供應鏈的影響力，仍是美國必須處理的重要風險。

政治施壓若失效 北京可能升高脅迫

報告指出，美國數十年來持續為中國可能發動的侵台戰爭做準備，但對海上隔離、封鎖等其他施壓情境的準備相對不足，因此呼籲國會與盟友合作，建立更完整的應變方案。
委員會將台灣定位為美國國家安全的「首要利益」，強調台灣對印太權力平衡、美國科技領導地位及經濟安全至關重要。台灣地位一旦改變，將牽動西太平洋軍事平衡、考驗外界對美國盟友體系的信心，並威脅關鍵科技供應鏈。
報告也關注北京在南海與印度洋日益強勢的行動，警告這些作法可能為更積極的活動及管轄權主張鋪路。
此外，委員會建議美國提升海底電纜維修能力，並關注外國對手參與維護經第三國連接美國的電纜，可能帶來的安全風險。

AI與供應鏈成角力焦點 籲堵出口管制漏洞

科技方面，委員會關注中國開放權重AI模型日益普及。企業可在自身的雲端運算環境部署這類模型，相較採用OpenAI、Anthropic等業者的尖端AI模型，能大幅降低成本。
委員會建議，使用中國企業AI模型的政府機關與企業，應向美國民眾揭露相關情況，例如將其列為向美國證券交易委員會(SEC)提交年度申報文件時揭露的業務風險；在未證明具備充分防護措施前，也應限制這類模型用於敏感領域。
報告並將出口管制定位為延緩中國科技發展的主要工具，強調成效取決於能否封堵漏洞，以及與盟友合作，避免管制遭到削弱。儘管中國已有進展，在尖端邏輯晶片製造、記憶體與半導體設備方面，仍未追上美國，預料未來一段時間也難以消除差距。
委員會呼籲加強檢視美國商務部工業暨安全局(BIS)核發的豁免，以及縮小限制範圍的決策，並確保對中晶片出口不會排擠美國自身需求。
供應鏈風險則不只限於關鍵礦物。報告指出，中國正擴大對農產品、金屬與能源市場的影響，涵蓋生產、加工，以及透過發展國內期貨市場影響定價。針對藥品原料供應，委員會建議美國制定採購策略，並與印度合作分散來源。
此外，委員會警告，中國大舉投資量子運算，美國應加速因應相關密碼安全風險。北京今日取得的加密資料，未來可能遭具備足夠能力的量子電腦解讀；用於驗證政府軟體、韌體與憑證的數位簽章，也可能面臨偽造威脅。
paras_en: According to Barron's on Wednesday (the 18th), the US‑China Economic and Security Review Commission (USCC) warned in its annual report that the next 24 months will be a crucial period for observing Beijing’s strategy toward Taiwan. If China finds that political influence and pressure to achieve unification are ineffective, it may shift to maritime isolation or a blockade of the island, and the commission urged the United States and its allies to develop contingency plans in advance.

The report was released as President Donald Trump was in Shenzhen preparing to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping, with both sides trying to preserve a fragile cease‑fire. The commission, however, noted that the Taiwan Strait, China’s expanding AI model capabilities, and Beijing’s influence over global commodity markets and supply chains remain major risks the United States must address.

If political pressure fails, Beijing could intensify coercion. The report says the United States has spent decades preparing for a possible Chinese invasion of Taiwan, but its preparations for maritime isolation or blockade scenarios are relatively lacking, and it calls on Congress and allies to build a more comprehensive response plan.

The commission designates Taiwan as a “primary interest” of US national security, stressing that Taiwan is vital to the Indo‑Pacific power balance, US technological leadership and economic security. A change in Taiwan’s status would affect the West Pacific military balance, test confidence in the US alliance system and threaten critical technology supply chains.

The report also flags Beijing’s increasingly assertive actions in the South China Sea and Indian Ocean, warning that these moves could pave the way for more aggressive activities and jurisdictional claims.

In addition, the commission recommends that the United States boost its capability to repair undersea cables and monitor security risks posed by foreign adversaries that might help maintain cables linking the US through third‑party nations.

AI and supply chains are a focal point of competition, and the commission warns that Chinese open‑weight AI models are becoming more widespread. Companies can deploy these models in their own cloud environments, which can cut costs dramatically compared with using cutting‑edge models from OpenAI, Anthropic and others.

The commission advises that government agencies and firms that use Chinese AI models should disclose this to the American public, for example by listing it as a business risk in their annual filings with the SEC, and that such models should be barred from sensitive areas until robust safeguards are proven.

The report positions export controls as the main tool to slow China’s tech advancement, emphasizing that effectiveness depends on sealing loopholes and cooperating with allies to prevent dilution. Although China has made progress, it still lags behind the US in advanced logic chip manufacturing, memory and semiconductor equipment, and the gap is expected to persist for the foreseeable future.

The commission calls for tighter scrutiny of exemptions issued by the Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) and for narrowing the scope of restrictions, while ensuring that chip exports to China do not crowd out US domestic demand.

Supply‑chain risks extend beyond critical minerals. The report notes that China is expanding its influence over agricultural products, metals and energy markets, covering production, processing and price setting through domestic futures markets. For pharmaceutical raw‑material supplies, the commission recommends the US develop procurement strategies and work with India to diversify sources.

Finally, the commission warns that China is heavily investing in quantum computing and the US should accelerate measures to address related cryptographic security risks. Encryption data obtained by Beijing today could later be deciphered by sufficiently powerful quantum computers, and digital signatures used to verify government software, firmware and certificates could become vulnerable to forgery.

items.title: 央行12月升息在即？ 三三會預期難避免、再籲政府助企業度過難關
items.title_en: Is a December Rate Hike by the Central Bank Imminent? The 33 Association Expects It Hard to Avoid and Urges Government Help for Companies
paras: 央行總裁楊金龍近期對新台幣走貶，釋出下(12)月升息風向，強調已足夠評估將「是否升息」列為選項，包括多家金融機構也預期，央行在12月具備升息條件。三三會理事長林伯豐今(18)日受訪時則表示，美元近日看起來較強勢，升息在所難免，但升息可能產生通膨，要考慮企業能否順利因應金融局勢，關鍵仍在於政府是否了解企業需求，並提供更周全的協助，挺企業度過難關。
據指出，國內有多家金控公司均指出，台幣近期受股市重挫影響，遭外資持續賣超台股，加上AI資本支出疑慮尚未消除影響，短期台幣貶值近33元，不僅偏弱，也加重輸入性通膨壓力，在台美利差及物價壓力下，央行的貨幣政策考量有機會將重新思考，
三三企業交流會今日於舉行11月例會前，林伯豐受訪時表示，目前美元走勢相對強勢，加上長期美國公債殖利率長期超過5％以上居高不下，判斷升息「恐難以避免！」，但政府只要好好處理就可過關。
林伯豐表示，升息預期會連帶帶來通膨壓力，但要看的是調整幅度有多大，對各經濟體及公司企業來說，對升息都有一定的承受能力，台灣只要因應得宜，應可讓衝擊化解。
林伯豐也呼籲，若一旦升息，政府更應體察民間與企業的處境，在融資貸款、租稅優惠與人才培育上應全力配合，協助企業撐過難關。
此外，對於台灣長年以來的傳產缺工問題，林伯豐則認為，這與政府的人才培育政策，2件事情息息相關，他期盼政府能拿出更具體的做法，例如加強本土人才培育並提供誘因留住人才，也要善加解決國外移工的住宿與引進等配套問題，並協助傳統產業突破人力困難瓶頸。
paras_en: Central Bank Governor Yang Jin‑long recently commented on the New Taiwan dollar’s depreciation, signaling a possible rate hike in December and emphasizing that it is now sufficient to consider “whether to raise rates” as an option. Several financial institutions also expect the central bank will have the conditions to raise rates in December. Lin Bo‑feng, chairman of the 33 Association, told reporters on the 18th that the dollar has seemed relatively strong lately, making a rate hike inevitable, but such a hike could generate inflation and the ability of firms to cope with the financial environment must be considered. The key remains whether the government understands corporate needs and provides more comprehensive assistance to help firms get through the difficulty.

It was noted that many domestic financial holding companies said the Taiwan dollar has recently been weakened by a sharp stock‑market decline, with foreign investors continuously selling Taiwanese equities. Coupled with lingering concerns over AI‑related capital expenditures, the TWD has depreciated about 33 NTD in the short term, not only appearing weak but also adding to imported‑inflation pressure. Under the Taiwan‑U.S. interest‑rate spread and price pressures, the central bank may need to rethink its monetary policy considerations.

At the 33 Business Exchange Association’s November meeting today, Lin Bo‑feng said the dollar’s relative strength and the long‑term U.S. Treasury yields staying above 5 % suggest that a rate hike “is hard to avoid,” but the government can get through it if it handles the situation properly.

Lin Bo‑feng added that a rate‑hike expectation will bring inflationary pressure, but the impact depends on how large the adjustment is. All economies and companies have some capacity to absorb rate hikes; Taiwan, if it responds appropriately, should be able to mitigate the shock.

Lin Bo‑feng also called for the government, should a rate hike occur, to be more attuned to the situation of the private sector and enterprises, fully supporting financing, tax incentives and talent development to help companies weather the storm.

Regarding Taiwan’s long‑standing labor shortage in traditional industries, Lin Bo‑feng said this is closely tied to the government’s talent‑development policies. He hopes the government will adopt concrete measures such as strengthening local talent cultivation with incentives to retain talent, addressing housing and entry issues for foreign workers, and helping traditional sectors overcome their manpower bottlenecks.

items.title: AI「金流」大洗牌！Q3全球創投飆1709億美元 3大關鍵產業帶動台鏈發光
items.title_en: AI "Cash Flow" Shakeup! Q3 Global Venture Capital Soars to $170.9 Billion, Three Key Industries Power Taiwan's Chain
paras: KPMG安侯建業今（18）日發布《2026年第3季創投脈動》報告，全球創投市場單季完成8341件交易，總投資高達1709億美元。雖自上半年高點回落，規模仍遠高於歷史平均，顯示資金並未退場，且加速向具備規模、技術門檻與戰略價值的企業集中，AI投資重心從單純的模型競賽，轉向基礎建設與實體應用，如算力、能源與機器人成三大新寵，台股或AI供應鏈可望續沾光。
觀察全球各區域表現，KPMG安侯建業創新與新創服務團隊協同主持會計師許明芳表示，美洲依然是創投主力，第3季投資額達1012億美元、共3947件交易，其中美國單國便囊括984億美元。亞洲以398億美元位居第二，歐洲則在6筆10億美元級大案帶動下，單季投資額衝上284億美元，創下16季新高；澳洲受惠於AI基礎設施大案，投資額也攀升至28.4億美元的多季高點。
大型交易持續主導全球資金流向，第3季共有35筆募資規模達10億美元以上的巨案，美國就包辦了23筆。單季最大交易為美國Databricks募得50億美元，其次是Crusoe的39億美元，中國Moonshot AI與法國Mistral AI也各完成35億美元募資。整體投資邏輯已明顯轉變，投資人正積極布局雲端運算、資料中心、晶片、能源與機器人等關鍵環節，且種子期以外的交易中位數普遍上升。
在亞洲與其他新興市場方面，亞洲第3季投資額雖較前季的446億美元略降至398億美元，仍處於近年相對高檔。其中中國市場貢獻272億美元，主要受AI、半導體、機器人及香港上市活動支撐；日本表現持平但審查趨嚴，印度則滑落至6季低點。非洲單季投資額成長至4.94億美元，但資金高度集中於奈及利亞移動金融Moove的2.5億美元大案，導致全球早期與種子期新創募資壓力加劇。
展望2026年第4季，許明芳認為全球創投將聚焦於AI落地、資源競逐與價值驗證三大主軸，資金會更重視企業的成長品質、算力能源掌握度及實際獲利能力。對台灣新創企業而言，若能充分結合本地在半導體、硬體製造與產業應用場域的深厚優勢，加速技術商業化並積極拓展國際市場，將極有機會在下一波AI基礎建設與深科技投資浪潮中占據關鍵地位。
paras_en: KPMG announced today (the 18th) its "Q3 2026 Venture Capital Pulse" report, showing that the global VC market completed 8,341 deals in the quarter, with total investment reaching $170.9 billion. Although it fell back from the first‑half peak, the scale remains far above historical averages, indicating that capital has not exited and is accelerating toward companies with size, technical barriers and strategic value. AI investment focus has shifted from pure model contests to infrastructure and physical applications, with compute power, energy and robotics emerging as the three new favorites, and Taiwan’s stock market or AI supply chain is expected to continue benefiting.

Observing regional performance, KPMG’s Innovation and Startup Services team, led by accountant Xu Mingfang, said the Americas remain the main VC engine, with $101.2 billion invested across 3,947 deals in Q3, of which the United States alone accounted for $98.4 billion. Asia ranked second with $39.8 billion, while Europe, driven by six deals in the $1 billion‑plus range, pushed its quarterly investment to $28.4 billion – a 16‑quarter high. Australia also saw its investment rise to a multi‑quarter peak of $2.84 billion, helped by a large AI infrastructure deal.

Large deals continued to dominate global capital flows, with 35 fundraising rounds exceeding $1 billion in Q3, 23 of which were in the United States. The biggest single deal was Databricks in the U.S., which raised $5 billion, followed by Crusoe’s $3.9 billion. China’s Moonshot AI and France’s Mistral AI each closed $3.5 billion rounds. The overall investment logic has clearly shifted, with investors actively positioning in cloud computing, data centers, chips, energy and robotics, and median deal sizes beyond seed stage have generally risen.

In Asia and other emerging markets, Q3 investment in Asia slipped slightly from the previous quarter’s $44.6 billion to $39.8 billion, but remains relatively high in recent years. China contributed $27.2 billion, driven mainly by AI, semiconductors, robotics and Hong Kong listings; Japan’s performance was flat but regulatory scrutiny tightened, while India fell to a six‑quarter low. Africa’s quarterly investment grew to $494 million, heavily concentrated in Nigeria’s mobile‑finance venture Moove, which alone secured $250 million, intensifying funding pressure on early‑stage and seed startups globally.

Looking ahead to Q4 2026, Xu Mingfang expects global venture capital to focus on three main pillars: AI implementation, resource competition and value validation, with capital placing greater emphasis on growth quality, compute‑energy control and actual profitability. For Taiwanese startups, fully leveraging local strengths in semiconductors, hardware manufacturing and industry application domains, accelerating technology commercialization and actively expanding into international markets will create strong opportunities to secure a pivotal role in the next wave of AI infrastructure and deep‑tech investment.

items.title: 逾7成歐商對台灣按讚！建議推「雙軌經濟」國發會籲簽署台歐免雙重課稅協定
items.title_en: Over 70% of European Businesses Praise Taiwan; Recommend "Dual-Track Economy"; National Development Council Urges Signing of Taiwan‑EU Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement
paras: 歐洲在台商務協會今（18）日發布2027年建議書，呼籲政府縮小產業發展差距並推動雙軌經濟，將AI紅利擴散至整體產業，提升台灣經濟韌性以因應泡沫風險。國發會主委葉俊顯回應，去年台歐雙邊貿易額已近750億美元，過去10年台商赴歐投資成長6.5倍，政府將持續優化經商環境與法規鬆綁，期許台歐簽署避免雙重課稅協定與投資保障協議，深化台歐經貿夥伴關係。
歐洲商會今年以展望台灣：促進雙軌經濟匯流為主題，聚焦前瞻經商環境、人才延攬與人口對策、能源與基礎設施、醫療保健體系等四大面向。歐洲商會理事長張合翕指出，前一年度建議書已有23%的議題取得進展，肯定政府努力，但目前以台積電 (2330-TW) 為首的供應鏈雖受惠AI帶動薪資成長，仍有許多產業未享受到AI紅利。
張合翕表示，政府應將AI帶來的效益擴及整體經濟，打造更廣泛且強健的經濟發展方針，避免經濟泡沫風險。他也呼籲台灣應降低現行制度對創新及經濟的限制，並在少子化挑戰下營造更友善的職場與育兒環境，同時適度放寬外國人才資格限制並簡化申請程序，以積極培育及延攬國際人才。
葉俊顯受邀出席代表政府接受建言，他強調，隨著全球供應鏈重組，台歐合作已從傳統經貿拓展至半導體、AI與綠能轉型。去年台歐雙邊貿易額近750億美元，過去10年台商赴歐投資更大幅成長6.5倍，加上去年華沙台灣貿易投資中心揭牌與今年在波蘭舉辦歐洲台灣形象展，均展現雙方日趨緊密的夥伴關係。
在經商環境與法規鬆綁方面，葉俊顯引述歐洲經貿辦事處上月調查指出，超過7成受訪歐商肯定台灣經商環境。政府正全力打造亞洲資產管理中心，過去2年多完成逾60項法規調適，高雄資產管理專區已吸引62家金融機構進駐；行政院也於今年6月成立國家人工智慧戰略特別委員會，積極推動AI新十大建設以強化應用與治理。
針對人才延攬與人口結構變遷，葉俊顯說明，政府已完成外國專業人才延攬及僱用法修法，全面優化國際人才在台工作、居留與社會保障待遇，未來將持續透過Talent Taiwan一站式服務協助外商攬才。此外，政府今年5月提出台灣人口對策新戰略家庭支持篇共18項措施，全方位營造友善育兒的職場環境。
在綠能與醫療方面，葉俊顯指出，國家氣候變遷對策委員會正引領台灣邁向淨零，並透過國家融資保證機制提供離岸風場最高8成融資保證；總統亦親自召集健康台灣推動委員會提升國人健康福祉。
葉俊顯最後表示，期盼台歐共同促成簽署避免雙重課稅協定與投資保障協議，降低跨境投資障礙，攜手打造具韌性的全球供應鏈。
paras_en: The European Business Association in Taiwan released a 2027 recommendation today, urging the government to narrow the industrial development gap and promote a dual‑track economy that spreads AI benefits across all sectors, enhancing Taiwan’s economic resilience against bubble risks. National Development Council (NDC) Chairperson Yeh Jun‑hsien responded that last year Taiwan‑EU bilateral trade reached nearly $75 billion, and Taiwanese investment in Europe has grown 6.5‑fold over the past decade. The government will continue to improve the business environment and deregulate, aiming for Taiwan‑EU to sign a double‑tax avoidance agreement and an investment protection treaty to deepen economic ties.

The European Chamber this year focused on “Taiwan Outlook: Promoting Dual‑Track Economic Convergence,” concentrating on four pillars: forward‑looking business environment, talent recruitment and demographic policies, energy and infrastructure, and the healthcare system. Chamber President Zhang He‑xi noted that 23% of the issues in last year’s recommendation have progressed, praising government efforts, but while the TSMC‑led supply chain benefits from AI‑driven wage growth, many industries have yet to reap AI dividends.

Zhang said the government should extend AI‑driven benefits to the whole economy, crafting a broader and stronger development strategy to avoid bubble risks. He also called for reducing current regulatory constraints on innovation and the economy, creating a more family‑friendly workplace and childcare environment amid low‑birth‑rate challenges, and moderately easing foreign talent qualification limits while simplifying application procedures to actively cultivate and attract international talent.

Invited to represent the government and receive advice, Yeh emphasized that as global supply chains are reshaped, Taiwan‑EU cooperation has expanded from traditional trade to semiconductors, AI, and green‑energy transformation. Last year bilateral trade approached $75 billion, Taiwanese investment in Europe surged 6.5‑fold over ten years, and the inauguration of the Taiwan Trade and Investment Center in Warsaw and this year’s European‑Taiwan showcase in Poland both illustrate the deepening partnership.

Regarding the business environment and deregulation, Yeh cited a survey by the European Economic and Trade Office last month showing that over 70% of surveyed European firms approve of Taiwan’s business climate. The government is fully building an Asian asset‑management hub, having adjusted more than 60 regulations in the past two years, and Kaohsiung’s asset‑management zone now hosts 62 financial institutions. The Executive Yuan also established a National AI Strategy Special Committee in June to drive ten new AI initiatives for stronger application and governance.

On talent recruitment and demographic shifts, Yeh explained that the government has completed amendments to the Foreign Professional Talent Recruitment and Employment Act, fully optimizing work, residence, and social‑security conditions for international talent. Future efforts will continue through the one‑stop “Talent Taiwan” service to help foreign firms recruit. In May, the government unveiled a new population strategy with 18 family‑support measures to create a workplace that is friendly to parenting.

In green energy and healthcare, Yeh noted that the National Climate Change Committee is steering Taiwan toward net‑zero emissions and that the national financing guarantee mechanism can provide up to 80% financing guarantees for offshore wind farms. The President also personally convened the Healthy Taiwan Promotion Committee to boost public health and wellbeing.

Yeh concluded by expressing hope that Taiwan and the EU will jointly secure a double‑tax avoidance agreement and an investment protection treaty, lowering cross‑border investment barriers and jointly building a resilient global supply chain.

items.title: AI避風港愈來愈貴！蘋果今年漲30% 估值衝2007年來最高
items.title_en: AI Safe Haven Gets More Expensive! Apple Up 30% This Year, Valuation Highest Since 2007
paras: 據《彭博》周三(18日)報導，當投資人拋售晶片、雲端與AI基礎建設相關股票時，蘋果(AAPL-US)卻成為資金避風港，今年來累計上漲約30%，表現居科技七巨頭之首，市值達5.1兆美元，登上全球最大企業寶座。
然而，追求穩定的代價也愈來愈高。蘋果未來12個月預估本益比已達37倍，為2007年以來最高，躋身標普500估值最昂貴的25檔股票之列，讓市場開始思考：這座AI避風港，是否已經太貴？

未跟進AI軍備競賽 穩定現金流吸引資金

蘋果今年不僅領先其他科技巨頭，也是標普500上漲的最大貢獻者，占該指數今年7.5%漲幅的約28%。周三早盤，蘋果股價再上漲約0.7%。
支撐買盤的關鍵，是蘋果沒有像其他大型科技企業一樣，大舉投入AI基礎建設競賽，而是持續銷售iPhone與Mac，等待技術成熟後，讓消費者透過旗下裝置使用AI服務。
相較之下，其他科技巨頭為追逐AI商機大幅增加資本支出，自由現金流也承受壓力。蘋果較克制的投資策略，反而成為市場震盪時的優勢。
伯恩斯坦分析師Mark Newman在11月12日報告中指出，蘋果較不受AI資料中心資本支出下滑的風險衝擊，也避開大型雲端業者自由現金流急降的壓力。他認為，考量客戶忠誠度、獲利持續性、成長、現金流與股東回報，蘋果目前的估值並非高得離譜。

股價跑在目標價前 成長放緩考驗高估值

不過，蘋果仍有基本面挑戰。公司本月稍早公布的利潤率展望令人失望，並面臨記憶體等零組件供應限制。市場預期，截至明年9月的2027會計年度營收將成長10%，低於2026會計年度的15%，之後兩年增速還可能進一步放緩。
依《彭博》數據，蘋果本益成長比(PEG)已達5.3，創2005年有紀錄以來最高。這項指標以本益比除以獲利成長率，數值偏高，意味投資人正為成長支付較高價格。相較之下，輝達(NVDA-US)因本會計年度獲利預期翻倍、估值卻下滑，PEG降至不到0.15的歷史低點。
華爾街也顯露猶豫。《彭博》追蹤的59名蘋果分析師中，僅36人給予買進評等；股價更已超過分析師平均目標價，成為科技七巨頭中，唯一以平均目標價計算、未來12個月隱含報酬為負的股票。
YieldMax ETFs策略師Mike Khouw提醒，蘋果目前波動偏低，但估值相較歷史已明顯偏高，進一步擴張的空間有限，投資人必須留意部分估值溢價消退的可能。
仍將蘋果列為年度五大首選之一的Niles Investment Management創辦人Dan Niles則認為，若AI持續發展，蘋果可透過手機與電腦受惠；若AI景氣反轉，也能提供相對防禦性。不過，即使看好蘋果在目前環境下的定位，他仍坦言不喜歡現在的估值。
paras_en: According to Bloomberg on Wednesday the 18th, while investors were dumping stocks tied to chips, cloud and AI infrastructure, Apple (AAPL-US) became a safe haven, climbing about 30% so far this year, ranking first among the seven big tech giants, with a market value of $5.1 trillion, taking the top spot as the world’s largest company.

However, the price of stability is rising. Apple’s forward P/E ratio for the next 12 months has reached 37 times earnings, the highest since 2007, placing it among the 25 most expensive S&P 500 stocks and prompting the market to wonder whether this AI safe haven has become too pricey.

Apple not only leads other tech giants this year but also is the biggest contributor to the S&P 500’s rise, accounting for roughly 28% of the index’s 7.5% gain so far. On Wednesday morning Apple’s shares rose another about 0.7%.

The key to the buying pressure is that Apple, unlike other large tech firms, has not poured massive money into the AI infrastructure race, instead continuing to sell iPhones and Macs while waiting for the technology to mature so consumers can use AI services through its devices.

By contrast, other tech giants have dramatically increased capital spending to chase AI opportunities, putting pressure on free cash flow. Apple’s more restrained investment strategy has become an advantage during market turbulence.

Bernstein analyst Mark Newman noted in a November 12 report that Apple is less exposed to the risk of a slowdown in AI data‑center capex and avoids the pressure of a sharp drop in free cash flow that large cloud providers face. He believes that given customer loyalty, earnings sustainability, growth, cash flow and shareholder returns, Apple’s current valuation is not absurdly high.

Nevertheless, Apple still faces fundamental challenges. The profit‑margin outlook released earlier this month was disappointing, and the company is dealing with component supply constraints such as memory. The market expects revenue for the fiscal year ending September 2027 to grow 10%, down from 15% for fiscal 2026, with growth possibly slowing further over the following two years.

Bloomberg data show Apple’s price‑to‑earnings‑to‑growth (PEG) ratio has risen to 5.3, the highest on record since 2005. This metric, which divides the P/E by earnings growth, is elevated, indicating investors are paying a premium for growth. By comparison, Nvidia (NVDA-US) sees its PEG fall to below 0.15, a historic low, as earnings expectations double while its valuation declines.

Wall Street also shows hesitation. Among the 59 Apple analysts tracked by Bloomberg, only 36 rate the stock as a buy; the share price has already surpassed analysts’ average target price, making Apple the only one of the seven big tech stocks whose implied 12‑month return, based on average target, is negative.

YieldMax ETFs strategist Mike Khouw cautions that Apple’s volatility is currently low, but its valuation is clearly elevated relative to history, leaving limited room for further expansion and raising the risk that part of the valuation premium could erode.

Dan Niles, founder of Niles Investment Management, still lists Apple as one of his top five picks for the year, arguing that if AI continues to develop, Apple can benefit through its phones and computers, and if AI sentiment reverses, the stock offers relative defensiveness. However, even though he likes Apple’s positioning in the current environment, he admits he does not like the present valuation.

items.title: 科技股預估本益比一年暴跌42%！Truist投資長喊進：市場悲觀情緒反成反彈訊號
items.title_en: Tech Stocks Forecast Forward P/E Plummets 42% in a Year! Truist CIO Calls It a Buying Opportunity as Market Pessimism Turns Into a Rebound Signal
paras: 在科技股估值經歷歷史性下修，投資人情緒也大幅惡化之後，Truist Advisory Services投資長Keith Lerner建議，目前科技股配置低於基準的投資人，可以開始考慮提高持股比重。
Lerner坦言，人工智慧(AI)交易仍面臨風險，尤其是輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳遭撤換，加深市場對領導層、晶片出口限制、融資環境、供需狀況，以及資料中心投資前景的疑慮。
但Lerner說：「市場不會等到不確定性完全消失才採取行動。市場往往在實際結果僅僅沒有預期中那麼糟時，就開始反轉。」
科技股占比高的那斯達克100指數已落入修正區間，周二(17日)收盤和10月6日高點相比回跌14%，將近三分之二成分股更進入熊市區間。
Lerner進一步指出，過去六個月以來，科技股相對標普500指數的表現已從9月底領先25%，轉為落後6%。
根據美國銀行(BofA)調查，全球AI熱潮的投資樂觀情緒正在消退，基金經理人對科技股的配置降幅創20年來最大。
Lerner認為，科技股表現落後、投資人情緒轉趨悲觀，反而是市場即將反彈的訊號，而非預告跌勢將進一步擴大。他指出，科技股預估本益比(forward P/E)過去12個月已下跌42%，是近30年來該產業最劇烈的估值修正之一。
儘管這波跌勢可能讓人聯想到網路泡沫，但Lerner說：「如今市場的起始條件與整體背景已大不相同。2000年市場觸頂前一年，科技股估值上漲逾100%。如今，科技股估值已跌破2022年底這波多頭行情啟動時的水準。」
當然，科技股投資並非毫無風險。Lerner指出，企業財報表現不如預期、利率走高，以及AI投資周期出現更大幅度的退潮，是他對市場展望最主要的威脅。
不過，此次估值修正「異常劇烈」，意味著只要企業獲利預估下修幅度沒有市場擔憂得那麼大，科技股就可能迅速反彈。
Lerner寫道：「雜誌封面往往被視為反向指標，因為當一個故事登上頭版時，相關論述通常已廣為人知，也可以說早已反映在市場價格中。恐懼與貪婪可能迅速轉變，市場也是如此。」
paras_en: After tech stock valuations underwent a historic downgrade and investor sentiment sharply deteriorated, Keith Lerner, CIO of Truist Advisory Services, suggested that investors whose tech allocation is below the benchmark can now start considering increasing their holdings.

Lerner admitted that AI trading still faces risks, especially after Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang was ousted, deepening market concerns about leadership, chip export restrictions, financing conditions, supply‑demand dynamics, and the outlook for data‑center investments.
But Lerner said, "The market won’t wait for all uncertainty to disappear before acting. It often turns around as soon as the actual outcome is not as bad as expected."

The Nasdaq‑100, which has a high weighting of tech stocks, has slipped into correction territory, closing on Tuesday the 17th down 14% from its October 6 peak, with nearly two‑thirds of its components now in bear‑market territory.
Lerner further noted that over the past six months the relative performance of tech stocks versus the S&P 500 has shifted from leading by 25% at the end of September to lagging by 6%.
According to a Bank of America survey, the global AI hype’s investment optimism is waning, and fund managers have cut their tech stock allocations by the biggest margin in 20 years.

Lerner believes that the lagging performance of tech stocks and the turn toward pessimistic sentiment actually signal an imminent market rebound rather than a further decline. He pointed out that the forward P/E for tech stocks has fallen 42% over the past 12 months, one of the steepest valuation corrections in the industry in the last 30 years.

Although this decline may evoke memories of the dot‑com bubble, Lerner said, "The market’s starting conditions and overall backdrop are vastly different today. A year before the 2000 peak, tech valuations rose more than 100%. Now, tech valuations have fallen below the level at the start of the bullish run at the end of 2022."

Of course, investing in tech stocks is not without risk. Lerner highlighted that weaker-than‑expected earnings, rising interest rates, and a deeper pull‑back in the AI investment cycle are the main threats to his market outlook.
However, this "exceptionally sharp" valuation correction means that as long as earnings revisions are not as severe as market fears suggest, tech stocks could rebound quickly.

Lerner wrote, "Magazine covers are often seen as contrarian indicators, because when a story makes the front page, the narrative is already widely known and essentially priced in. Fear and greed can flip rapidly, and the market is no different."

items.title: SpaceX假設對OpenAI「零銷售」！馬斯克反擊奧特曼AI晶片需求遭高估言論
items.title_en: SpaceX Assumes Zero Sales to OpenAI! Musk Counters Altman's Claim That AI Chip Demand Is Overestimated
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US)執行長馬斯克透露，公司目前假設對OpenAI的銷售額為零。馬斯克發表這番言論前，OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）才針對半導體產業可能高估需求一事，進一步說明先前的看法。馬斯克與奧特曼長期以來對OpenAI的本質與發展方向存在分歧。
根據《Wccftech》報導，奧特曼日前表示，資料中心的需求與建置規模可能存在上限，未必能消化供應鏈中所有即將到貨的晶片庫存。對此，馬斯克則在社群平台X發文反擊。
稍早，奧特曼在Semafor舉辦的一場活動中，談及自己向三星(005930KS) 主管表示AI晶片需求可能遭到高估的相關言論。
AI晶片需求是目前AI產業建設熱潮的核心議題，奧特曼先前也曾討論新興雲端業者（neocloud）在需求估算中扮演的角色。
奧特曼當時向三星主管表示，市場趨勢顯示，每家新興雲端業者在估算需求時，都可能將OpenAI與Anthropic的需求納入考量，導致整體晶片需求被高估，因為這兩家大型軟體公司可能只會使用部分新興雲端業者的基礎設施。
在此基礎上，奧特曼16日進一步表示：「我認為，需求以及資料中心的建置趨勢都相當穩健。但我們並不需要、也不可能，向每一家晶片供應商採購所有的供應量。」
然而，同時掌舵SpaceX與特斯拉(TSLA-US) 的馬斯克認為，如果OpenAI的產品表現無法帶動資料中心算力需求快速成長，那麼該公司就應該檢視自身產品是否出了問題。
馬斯克寫道：「SpaceX假設對OpenAI的銷售額為零。如果OpenAI的需求沒有快速攀升，那麼他們的產品一定出了問題。」
SpaceX今年稍早在首次公開募股（IPO）相關文件中揭露，公司已成為運算基礎設施供應商，業務涵蓋地面資料中心園區，以及未來透過衛星星座在太空提供運算服務的計畫。
SpaceX之所以躋身業界最大型運算服務供應商之列，部分仰賴旗下Colossus資料中心等設施。這些資料中心已與Google(GOOGL-US) 及Anthropic達成協議，將提供運算能力。
分析指出，從馬斯克的說法來看，他相信SpaceX即使不依賴OpenAI，也能充分運用自身所有的晶片運算產能。
此外，馬斯克同樣不看好新興雲端業者，先前曾預測這類業者將面臨「孔雀魚級別的大規模死亡」（guppy-level death）。
與此同時，馬斯克旗下Colossus資料中心計畫在2026年底前，讓超過120萬顆輝達(NVDA-US) GPU投入運作，目標是打造全球規模最大的運算叢集。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk disclosed that the company currently assumes zero sales to OpenAI. Musk made this remark after OpenAI CEO Sam Altman addressed the possibility that the semiconductor industry may have overestimated demand, further explaining his earlier view. Musk and Altman have long disagreed on OpenAI's nature and development direction.

According to a report by Wccftech, Altman recently said that data‑center demand and build‑out scale may have an upper limit and might not be able to absorb all the chip inventory soon arriving in the supply chain. Musk responded to this on the social platform X.
Earlier, Altman at a Semafor‑hosted event mentioned his comments to a Samsung (005930KS) executive that AI‑chip demand could be overestimated.
AI‑chip demand is a core issue in the current AI industry construction boom, and Altman has previously discussed the role of emerging cloud providers (neocloud) in demand estimates.

Altman told the Samsung executive that market trends show each emerging cloud provider may factor OpenAI and Anthropic demand into its estimates, inflating overall chip demand because these two large software firms may only use a portion of the emerging clouds' infrastructure.
Building on that, Altman said on the 16th: "I think demand and data‑center build‑out trends are quite robust. But we don’t need, nor can we, purchase the entire supply from every chip supplier."

However, Elon Musk, who also runs Tesla (TSLA-US), believes that if OpenAI’s products fail to drive rapid growth in data‑center compute demand, the company should examine whether its products have problems.
Musk wrote: "SpaceX assumes zero sales to OpenAI. If OpenAI’s demand doesn’t surge quickly, then their product must be flawed."

Earlier this year, SpaceX disclosed in its IPO filing that it has become a provider of compute infrastructure, covering ground data‑center campuses and plans to offer compute services from a satellite constellation in space.

SpaceX’s rise to become one of the industry’s largest compute service providers is partly due to facilities such as its Colossus data centers, which have agreements with Google (GOOGL-US) and Anthropic to supply compute power.
Analysts note that from Musk’s comments, he believes SpaceX can fully utilize all its chip compute capacity even without relying on OpenAI.
Musk also remains skeptical of emerging cloud providers, having previously predicted they would face a "guppy‑level mass death."
Meanwhile, Musk’s Colossus data‑center project aims to have over 1.2 million NVIDIA (NVDA-US) GPUs operational by the end of 2026, targeting the creation of the world’s largest compute cluster.

items.title: 雲端巨頭狂發債9400億美元！惠譽警告AI發債潮恐引爆公司債市場波動
items.title_en: Cloud Giants Flood the Market with $940 Billion in Debt! Fitch Warns AI Debt Surge Could Spark Volatility in Corporate Bond Market
paras: 國際信評機構惠譽（Fitch Ratings）發布最新報告指出，隨著高評級超大規模雲端服務商（hyperscalers）大舉發債以支應龐大的AI資本支出，美國投資等級非金融公司債市場正日益集中於科技、電信及零售等少數產業。2026年截至10月底，美國相關公司債發行總額已達9400億美元、年增33%，惠譽警告產業分散度降低恐加劇市場波動。
惠譽在報告中分析，這波發債規模激增主要受惠於AI相關債務發行潮帶動，使今年前10月美國投資等級非金融公司債發行量較去年同期大幅成長33%。由於科技巨頭持續投入算力與資料中心等基礎建設，龐大的融資需求推動債市結構快速向特定產業傾斜，進而墊高了整體投資等級公司債市場的風險水準。
隨著債市集中度提高與潛在波動加劇，惠譽進一步示警，部分發債機構未來恐面臨更為緊縮的融資環境。特別是在美國公債殖利率持續維持高檔的情況下，一旦超大規模雲端業者的信用體質轉弱，或是市場對其股票估值產生疑慮，將直接引發信用利差擴大，進一步牽動整體公司債市場的定價與籌資難度。
在借貸成本居高不下的環境中，企業債務再融資的難度也隨之攀升。惠譽點名醫療保健、科技以及公用事業等近期有大量債務即將到期的產業，其面臨的營運與財務風險將會被放大。這些發債機構不僅必須承受更高的利息支出，在進行債務展延或再融資時，更需要精準抓準市場窗口伺機發債，以降低籌資衝擊。
展望後續發債動能，惠譽預期短期內龐大的AI相關債務發行仍將持續，以支撐未完成的基礎建設計畫。不過，若AI龐大資本支出的實際投資報酬率持續存在不確定性，導致機構投資人的認購需求出現起伏與觀望，未來雲端巨頭與AI相關企業的發債節奏，恐怕會從目前的熱絡轉變為較為零星的狀態。
paras_en: Fitch Ratings released a new report stating that as highly rated, ultra‑large cloud service providers (hyperscalers) issue massive amounts of debt to fund huge AI capital expenditures, the U.S. investment‑grade non‑financial corporate bond market is becoming increasingly concentrated in a few sectors such as technology, telecommunications and retail. By the end of October 2026, total issuance by these U.S. companies had reached $940 billion, up 33% year‑over‑year, and Fitch warns that the reduced industry diversification could amplify market volatility.

The report analyzes that the surge in issuance is driven primarily by the wave of AI‑related debt offerings, which has caused U.S. investment‑grade non‑financial corporate bond issuance in the first ten months of this year to jump 33% compared with the same period last year. Ongoing spending by tech giants on computing power and data‑center infrastructure creates huge financing needs, pushing the bond market’s composition sharply toward these sectors and raising the overall risk level of the investment‑grade corporate bond market.

With bond‑market concentration rising and potential volatility increasing, Fitch further cautions that some issuers may face a tighter financing environment in the future. In particular, as U.S. Treasury yields remain high, a weakening credit profile of the ultra‑large cloud players or doubts about their equity valuations could trigger widening credit spreads, affecting pricing and fundraising conditions across the corporate bond market.

In an environment of persistently high borrowing costs, refinancing corporate debt becomes more difficult. Fitch points to healthcare, technology and utilities as sectors with a large amount of debt maturing soon, whose operational and financial risks will be magnified. These issuers will not only have to bear higher interest expenses but also must time the market precisely when extending or refinancing debt to lessen the impact on fundraising.

Looking ahead, Fitch expects the massive AI‑related debt issuance to continue in the short term to support unfinished infrastructure projects. However, if the actual return on the huge AI capital outlays remains uncertain, causing institutional investors’ demand to fluctuate and become more cautious, the pace of debt issuance by cloud giants and AI‑related firms may shift from the current fervor to a more sporadic pattern.

paras: 美股主要指數周三(18日)漲跌互現，其中標普500與那斯達克綜合指數雙雙上揚。輝達(NVDA-US)財報優於預期，並釋出強勁營收展望，緩解投資人對公司成長前景與AI投資熱潮能否延續的疑慮，帶動科技股買氣回溫。
市場同時關注Anthropic(預定股號：ANT-US)即將登場的IPO，觀察AI類股風險偏好能否進一步回升。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌近230點或近0.5%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近70點或近0.3%，標普 500 指數跌0.02%，費城半導體指數跌近0.4%，台積電ADR漲近0.5%。
輝達(NVDA-US)強勁展望緩解投資人對人工智慧(AI)交易能否延續的疑慮，帶動美股期貨走高。不過，聯準會(Fed)理事華勒呼籲考慮12月升息2碼，使早盤較大的漲幅收斂，短天期美債價格也由漲轉跌。

輝達展望穩軍心 AI投資動能仍強

輝達上調2028年營收成長目標，讓市場對公司能否在黃仁勳離職後維持成長動能，獲得部分 reassurance。財報也帶動其他遭到拋售的AI概念股反彈，雲端業者Nebius(NBIS-US)、CoreWeave(CRWV-US)盤前走揚，南韓三星電子(005930-KS)、SK海力士(SKHY-US)(000660-KS)股價同步上漲，歐洲科技股也表現突出。
道富環球市場分析師Marija Veitmane表示，輝達財報與展望再次印證其他科技公司的說法：AI資本支出強勁，幾乎沒有放緩跡象。她認為，強勁獲利搭配較低估值與投資人持倉，使科技股具備投資吸引力。
不過，市場仍關注輝達未來是否繼續大力支持整個AI產業。代理執行長克瑞斯已暗示，投資策略可能更重視紀律；董事長瓊斯排除黃仁勳回任，也使公司治理與接班方向持續受到檢視。
The Sevens Report分析師Tom Essaye指出，輝達與CoreWeave若開高後持續擴大漲幅，可能意味科技股修正接近尾聲；若兩者開高卻收黑，則顯示投資人仍趁反彈減碼AI基礎建設部位。

升息陰影壓抑漲勢 Anthropic IPO成下個考驗

華勒周三表示，通膨仍朝錯誤方向發展，呼籲Fed考慮12月升息2碼。這番鷹派言論壓抑股市期貨漲幅，並使短天期美債價格由漲轉跌。
其他資產方面，美元上漲約0.2%，布蘭特原油在每桶93美元附近震盪，銅價下跌，黃金則今年首度跌破每盎司3,800美元。
除了輝達，投資人也關注Anthropic首次公開發行(IPO)，以及川普、習近平與俄羅斯總統普丁在深圳的會談動向。
據悉，Anthropic正向潛在投資人釋出訊息，預期發行價將落在承銷區間上緣，甚至高於區間，預定周三定價。
Pepperstone策略師Dilin Wu表示，Anthropic IPO將是AI產業風險偏好的下一場考驗。若股票在高估值下仍能持續吸引買盤，可能進一步支撐整體AI類股的投資情緒。
