items.title: 黃仁勳還要赴參院作證！美商務部長也點頭 國會追查輝達風波
items.title_en: Jensen Huang to Testify Before Senate; Commerce Secretary Also Approves, Congress Probes Nvidia Controversy
paras: 據《CNBC》周三(18日)報導，美國參議院銀行委員會主席史考特(Tim Scott)證實，輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳與商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)，均已同意自願出席委員會作證。這是黃仁勳同意接受眾議院閉門訪談之外，另一項國會作證安排。
史考特接受《CNBC》節目「Squawk Box」訪問時表示：「他們兩人都已同意。我們希望能在聖誕節前完成。」參院聽證的確切日期目前尚未公布，史考特先前要求黃仁勳公開作證。
史考特表示，作證將有助委員會釐清，兩人「知道哪些事情、何時得知，以及為何沒有採取行動」。
他並將矛頭指向盧特尼克，表示相關官員早在今年3月就已被提醒，應將新加坡業者Megaspeed列入美國商務部的「實體清單」。這份名單針對美方認定涉及國安等風險的企業，實施出口限制。
史考特批評，商務部工業暨安全局(BIS)與盧特尼克均未採取這項行動，「我們想知道為什麼」。
Megaspeed曾向輝達購買晶片，美國調查人員懷疑該公司涉嫌將晶片轉流中國。黃仁勳婚外關係對象黃樂(Alice Huang)曾任該公司高階主管，並被美方懷疑涉及中國情報活動。相關爭議曝光後，黃仁勳已於上周辭去輝達執行長職務。
隨著風波擴大，盧特尼克與財政部長貝森特之間的分歧也浮上檯面。貝森特上周五接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，財政部長期支持對Megaspeed實施限制。至於商務部為何未採取行動，他表示：「你們必須詢問他們的內部程序。」
眾議院方面，黃仁勳周二已與外交委員會、對中事務特別委員會及情報委員會主席達成協議，將於12月1日接受三個委員會聯合進行的閉門訪談，並製作逐字紀錄。
黃仁勳發言人對於史考特宣布他同意赴參院作證一事，拒絕評論。
paras_en: According to CNBC on Wednesday (the 18th), U.S. Senate Banking Committee Chairman Tim Scott confirmed that Nvidia (NVDA-US) former CEO Jensen Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick have both agreed to voluntarily appear before the committee to testify. This follows Huang’s agreement to a closed-door interview with the House and represents another congressional testimony arrangement.

Scott told CNBC’s “Squawk Box” that “both of them have agreed. We hope to finish before Christmas.” The exact date for the Senate hearing has not yet been announced, and Scott had previously asked Huang to testify publicly.
Scott said the testimony would help the committee clarify what the two knew, when they knew it, and why they did not take action.

He also pointed the finger at Lutnick, noting that officials were warned as early as March this year that Singapore‑based Megaspeed should be placed on the U.S. Commerce Department’s Entity List, which restricts exports to companies deemed a national‑security risk.
Scott criticized the Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) and Lutnick for not taking that step, saying, “We want to know why.”

Megaspeed had purchased chips from Nvidia, and U.S. investigators suspect the company was diverting the chips to China. Huang’s former partner, Alice Huang, who once held a senior position at Megaspeed, is also suspected by U.S. authorities of involvement in Chinese intelligence activities. After the controversy surfaced, Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO last week.

As the scandal grew, a rift between Lutnick and Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen became public. Yellen told CNBC last Friday that the Treasury has long supported restricting Megaspeed. When asked why the Commerce Department had not acted, she said, “You have to ask them about their internal process.”

In the House, Huang reached an agreement on Tuesday with the chairs of the Foreign Affairs Committee, the Select Committee on the China Task Force, and the Intelligence Committee to undergo a joint closed‑door interview on December 1, with a verbatim transcript to be produced.
Huang’s spokesperson declined to comment on Scott’s announcement that he had agreed to appear before the Senate.

items.title: 過去一年只有「兩家」七巨頭股價跑贏標普500！「這項差異」成關鍵
items.title_en: Only Two of the Seven Tech Giants Outperformed the S&P 500 Over the Past Year! This Difference Was Key
paras: 美股科技巨頭「七巨頭」（Magnificent Seven）過去一年多數未能跑贏大盤，反映投資人對科技股的選擇日益挑剔。在人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮持續之際，Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 與蘋果(AAPL-US) 成為七巨頭中唯二績效超越標普500指數的企業，分析師認為，兩家公司採取不同於同業的AI布局策略，是股價表現相對突出的原因。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，自2025年初以來，Alphabet股價累計上漲50.8%，蘋果也上漲42%，雙雙領先同期報酬率達29%的標普500指數。
相較之下，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、Meta(META-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 、輝達(NVDA-US) 及特斯拉(TSLA-US) 股價表現均落後大盤。
晨星（Morningstar）分析師 William Kerwin 表示，市場正在「挑選AI贏家」。
他指出，Alphabet受到投資人青睞，部分原因在於旗下張量處理單元（TPU）晶片可與輝達產品競爭；此外，Alphabet旗下尖端AI模型Gemini，也具備與OpenAI及Anthropic產品競爭的實力。
蘋果則採取不同策略。Kerwin表示，儘管沒有自有AI模型，該公司仍透過合作夥伴關係導入AI技術，將其作為改善使用者體驗的工具，同時在AI研發上的支出明顯低於同業。
相較之下，Kerwin指出，微軟、亞馬遜與Meta因大舉投入AI基礎設施而受到市場懲罰。
Tandem Investment Advisors共同投資長 Ben Carew 也認為，蘋果選擇不跟進部分七巨頭企業的AI軍備競賽，是明智決定。他指出，其他科技巨頭正投入龐大資金爭奪AI市場，這些支出未必能帶來同等程度的投資回報。
MoffettNathanson分析師 Craig Moffett 則表示，蘋果的吸引力恰恰在於其股價與整體AI投資題材的連動性較低。當投資人開始擔憂主要競爭對手能否從AI基礎設施支出中獲利時，便可能轉向蘋果，將其視為相對安全的選擇。
不過，蘋果並非沒有挑戰。Moffett 認為，iPhone 18系列的市場表現遠不如去年iPhone 17系列；此外，AI代理（AI Agents）也可能繞過蘋果既有生態系統，削弱該公司對自身系統的掌控能力。
Alphabet方面，自2025年初以來，投資人對該公司的態度出現明顯轉變。Carew 指出，Alphabet部分憑藉TPU業務，成功將自身定位為AI市場的重要競爭者，甚至可能已侵蝕輝達在晶片市場的部分市占率及主導地位。
不過，蘋果與Alphabet近期股價表現已出現分歧。蘋果股價目前較上周創下的收盤高點下跌不到2%，Alphabet股價則較今年5月創下的收盤高點回落約30%。
paras_en: U.S. tech giants known as the “Magnificent Seven” largely failed to beat the market over the past year, reflecting investors’ increasingly picky selection of tech stocks. Amid the ongoing AI investment frenzy, Alphabet (GOOGL-US) and Apple (AAPL-US) were the only two of the seven whose performance surpassed the S&P 500 index, and analysts say the two companies’ AI strategies that differ from their peers explain the relative stock‑price strength.
According to MarketWatch, since the start of 2025 Alphabet’s stock has risen 50.8% and Apple’s has risen 42%, both well ahead of the S&P 500’s 29% total return over the same period.
By contrast, the shares of Amazon (AMZN-US), Meta (META-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US), Nvidia (NVDA-US) and Tesla (TSLA-US) all lagged the broader market.
Morningstar analyst William Kerwin said the market is “picking AI winners.”

He noted that Alphabet is favored in part because its Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) chips can compete with Nvidia’s products, and its cutting‑edge AI model Gemini is capable of taking on offerings from OpenAI and Anthropic.

Apple takes a different approach. Kerwin said that even without its own AI model, the company leverages partnerships to bring AI technology into its products as a tool for improving user experience, while spending far less on AI R&D than its peers.
Kerwin added that Microsoft, Amazon and Meta have been punished by the market for pouring massive money into AI infrastructure.

Ben Carew, co‑Chief Investment Officer at Tandem Investment Advisors, also believes Apple’s decision not to join the AI arms race that many of the other Magnificent Seven are engaged in was wise. He said other tech giants are committing huge sums to capture AI market share, but those expenditures may not deliver comparable returns.

MoffettNathanson analyst Craig Moffett said Apple’s appeal lies precisely in its stock’s relatively low correlation with the broader AI investment theme. When investors worry about whether major rivals can profit from AI‑infrastructure spending, they may shift to Apple as a relatively safe alternative.

However, Apple does face challenges. Moffett points out that the iPhone 18 series is performing far worse than last year’s iPhone 17 series, and AI agents could bypass Apple’s existing ecosystem, weakening the company’s control over its own systems.

On the Alphabet side, investor sentiment has shifted noticeably since early 2025. Carew said Alphabet, partly thanks to its TPU business, has positioned itself as a key AI market competitor and may already be eroding Nvidia’s market share and dominance in the chip sector.

Nevertheless, Apple’s and Alphabet’s recent stock moves have diverged. Apple’s share is down less than 2% from the closing high it set last week, while Alphabet’s stock has fallen about 30% from the closing peak it reached in May this year.

items.title: 12月升息2碼？Fed華勒：可能得讓大家「震撼一下」
items.title_en: December Rate Hike of Two Basis Points? Fed's Waller Says a Shock May Be Needed
paras: 據《CNBC》周三(18日)報導，聯準會(Fed)理事華勒(Christopher Waller)表示，通膨持續高於預期，且價格壓力正在擴散，Fed可能必須採取更積極的行動，甚至讓大家「震撼一下」。他認為，12月可能需要升息2碼(50個基點)，但若能明確預告明年1月再升息，也可採取分次調升的方式。
華勒接受《CNBC》節目「Squawk Box」訪問時表示：「我非常、非常擔心通膨。它正朝錯誤方向發展，而且正在擴散。」他強調，若真想讓通膨降下來，就必須開始採取更積極的行動。

12月升2碼 或明確預告1月再升

華勒表示，Fed在12月8日至9日的聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)會議上，可能有必要升息2碼(0.5個百分點)。不過，若12月先升息1碼，並清楚向市場傳達1月將再升息，也不一定需要一次調升2碼。
華勒說：「如果不打算非常清楚地向市場表明，1月還會再升息，那我的看法就是，12月必須升息2碼，把政策落實到位。」
這項選擇也涉及Fed的溝通方式。主席華許(Kevin Warsh)一直反對這類前瞻指引，認為預先承諾政策路徑會限制決策官員的行動空間。
華勒早在11月10日便警告，若10月核心消費者物價指數(CPI)月增率達0.3%或更高，Fed就應考慮12月升息2碼，否則可能損及抗通膨公信力。隨後公布的核心CPI月增0.3%，達到他先前提出的門檻。www.federalreserve.gov

去年降息可能得全數收回 官員對步調仍有分歧

華勒認為，Fed首先必須收回2025年三次、每次1碼的「預防性降息」，而且可能還得進一步收緊政策。他指出，若2025年夏季的政策利率都無法讓通膨下降，單純回到當時水準，未必足以解決問題。
Fed去年因擔心勞動市場轉弱，並預期通膨將持續朝2%目標回落而降息。然而，今年2月底美國與以色列對伊朗發動攻擊後，能源價格飆升，加上關稅影響延續，通膨再度升溫。Fed因此於9月啟動三年多來首次升息，10月則維持利率不變。
儘管多數官員認同仍需收緊政策，對升息速度的看法卻不一致。聖路易聯準銀行總裁穆沙廉(Alberto Musalem)周二提出，到2027年春季可能需要升息多達四次；克里夫蘭與達拉斯聯準銀行總裁則支持較漸進的緊縮步調。
紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)周二接受《Axios》訪問時表示，目前情勢不需要採取大幅度行動，並認為Fed近幾個月蒐集數據、分析討論後再決策的方式運作良好。
根據芝商所FedWatch工具，利率期貨已充分反映12月升息1碼，並預期明年1月再升息，之後至2027年底前至少還有一次升息。Fed預定於台灣時間周四(19日)凌晨3點公布10月會議紀錄，提供更多官員討論政策路徑的線索。
paras_en: According to CNBC on Wednesday the 18th, Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said that inflation remains higher than expected and price pressures are spreading, so the Fed may have to take more aggressive action, even giving markets a "shock." He thinks a 50‑basis‑point hike could be needed in December, but if the Fed can clearly signal another hike in January it could also raise rates in stages.

In an interview on CNBC’s "Squawk Box" Waller said, "I am very, very worried about inflation. It’s moving in the wrong direction and it’s spreading." He stressed that if inflation is to be brought down, more aggressive action must begin now.

Waller said the Fed may need to raise rates by two basis points (0.5 percentage point) at the FOMC meeting on Dec. 8‑9. However, if the Fed raises only one basis point in December and clearly signals a further hike in January, a single 0.5‑point move may not be necessary.

Waller added, "If you’re not going to be crystal‑clear with the market that there will be another hike in January, then my view is that the December move has to be two basis points to fully implement policy."

This choice also touches on the Fed’s communication style. Chair Kevin Warsh has consistently opposed forward guidance of this sort, arguing that pre‑committing to a policy path limits the flexibility of policymakers.

Waller warned on Nov. 10 that if core CPI for October rose 0.3% month‑over‑month or higher, the Fed should consider a two‑basis‑point hike in December, or risk damaging its anti‑inflation credibility. The subsequently released core CPI did rise 0.3%, hitting his threshold. www.federalreserve.gov

Last year’s rate cuts may have to be fully unwound, and officials still differ on the pace. Waller believes the Fed must first reverse the three one‑basis‑point “preventive” cuts scheduled for 2025 and may need to tighten further. He noted that if policy rates in summer 2025 cannot bring inflation down, simply returning to earlier levels may not solve the problem.

The Fed cut rates last year out of concern that the labor market was weakening and that inflation would keep moving toward the 2% target. However, after the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran at the end of February, energy prices spiked and tariff effects persisted, reigniting inflation. The Fed therefore began its first rate hike in over three years in September and held rates steady in October.

Although most officials agree policy needs tightening, they disagree on the speed of hikes. St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem said on Tuesday that up to four hikes may be needed by spring 2027, while the Cleveland and Dallas Fed presidents favor a more gradual tightening approach.

New York Fed President John Williams told Axios on Tuesday that the current situation does not call for large‑scale action and that the Fed’s recent practice of gathering data, analyzing and discussing before deciding has been working well.

According to the CME FedWatch tool, rate‑futures markets have fully priced in a one‑basis‑point hike in December and expect another hike in January, with at least one more hike anticipated before the end of 2027. The Fed is scheduled to release the minutes of the October meeting at 3 a.m. Taiwan time on Thursday the 19th, which should provide more clues about officials’ policy path discussions.

items.title: AI避風港愈來愈貴！蘋果今年漲30% 估值衝2007年來最高
items.title_en: AI Safe Haven Gets More Expensive! Apple Up 30% This Year, Valuation Highest Since 2007
paras: 據《彭博》周三(18日)報導，當投資人拋售晶片、雲端與AI基礎建設相關股票時，蘋果(AAPL-US)卻成為資金避風港，今年來累計上漲約30%，表現居科技七巨頭之首，市值達5.1兆美元，登上全球最大企業寶座。
然而，追求穩定的代價也愈來愈高。蘋果未來12個月預估本益比已達37倍，為2007年以來最高，躋身標普500估值最昂貴的25檔股票之列，讓市場開始思考：這座AI避風港，是否已經太貴？

未跟進AI軍備競賽 穩定現金流吸引資金

蘋果今年不僅領先其他科技巨頭，也是標普500上漲的最大貢獻者，占該指數今年7.5%漲幅的約28%。周三早盤，蘋果股價再上漲約0.7%。
支撐買盤的關鍵，是蘋果沒有像其他大型科技企業一樣，大舉投入AI基礎建設競賽，而是持續銷售iPhone與Mac，等待技術成熟後，讓消費者透過旗下裝置使用AI服務。
相較之下，其他科技巨頭為追逐AI商機大幅增加資本支出，自由現金流也承受壓力。蘋果較克制的投資策略，反而成為市場震盪時的優勢。
伯恩斯坦分析師Mark Newman在11月12日報告中指出，蘋果較不受AI資料中心資本支出下滑的風險衝擊，也避開大型雲端業者自由現金流急降的壓力。他認為，考量客戶忠誠度、獲利持續性、成長、現金流與股東回報，蘋果目前的估值並非高得離譜。

股價跑在目標價前 成長放緩考驗高估值

不過，蘋果仍有基本面挑戰。公司本月稍早公布的利潤率展望令人失望，並面臨記憶體等零組件供應限制。市場預期，截至明年9月的2027會計年度營收將成長10%，低於2026會計年度的15%，之後兩年增速還可能進一步放緩。
依《彭博》數據，蘋果本益成長比(PEG)已達5.3，創2005年有紀錄以來最高。這項指標以本益比除以獲利成長率，數值偏高，意味投資人正為成長支付較高價格。相較之下，輝達(NVDA-US)因本會計年度獲利預期翻倍、估值卻下滑，PEG降至不到0.15的歷史低點。
華爾街也顯露猶豫。《彭博》追蹤的59名蘋果分析師中，僅36人給予買進評等；股價更已超過分析師平均目標價，成為科技七巨頭中，唯一以平均目標價計算、未來12個月隱含報酬為負的股票。
YieldMax ETFs策略師Mike Khouw提醒，蘋果目前波動偏低，但估值相較歷史已明顯偏高，進一步擴張的空間有限，投資人必須留意部分估值溢價消退的可能。
仍將蘋果列為年度五大首選之一的Niles Investment Management創辦人Dan Niles則認為，若AI持續發展，蘋果可透過手機與電腦受惠；若AI景氣反轉，也能提供相對防禦性。不過，即使看好蘋果在目前環境下的定位，他仍坦言不喜歡現在的估值。
paras_en: According to Bloomberg on Wednesday the 18th, while investors were dumping stocks tied to chips, cloud and AI infrastructure, Apple (AAPL-US) became a safe haven, climbing about 30% so far this year, ranking first among the seven big tech giants, with a market value of $5.1 trillion, taking the top spot as the world’s largest company.

However, the price of stability is rising. Apple’s forward P/E ratio for the next 12 months has reached 37 times earnings, the highest since 2007, placing it among the 25 most expensive S&P 500 stocks and prompting the market to wonder whether this AI safe haven has become too pricey.

Apple not only leads other tech giants this year but also is the biggest contributor to the S&P 500’s rise, accounting for roughly 28% of the index’s 7.5% gain so far. On Wednesday morning Apple’s shares rose another about 0.7%.

The key to the buying pressure is that Apple, unlike other large tech firms, has not poured massive money into the AI infrastructure race, instead continuing to sell iPhones and Macs while waiting for the technology to mature so consumers can use AI services through its devices.

By contrast, other tech giants have dramatically increased capital spending to chase AI opportunities, putting pressure on free cash flow. Apple’s more restrained investment strategy has become an advantage during market turbulence.

Bernstein analyst Mark Newman noted in a November 12 report that Apple is less exposed to the risk of a slowdown in AI data‑center capex and avoids the pressure of a sharp drop in free cash flow that large cloud providers face. He believes that given customer loyalty, earnings sustainability, growth, cash flow and shareholder returns, Apple’s current valuation is not absurdly high.

Nevertheless, Apple still faces fundamental challenges. The profit‑margin outlook released earlier this month was disappointing, and the company is dealing with component supply constraints such as memory. The market expects revenue for the fiscal year ending September 2027 to grow 10%, down from 15% for fiscal 2026, with growth possibly slowing further over the following two years.

Bloomberg data show Apple’s price‑to‑earnings‑to‑growth (PEG) ratio has risen to 5.3, the highest on record since 2005. This metric, which divides the P/E by earnings growth, is elevated, indicating investors are paying a premium for growth. By comparison, Nvidia (NVDA-US) sees its PEG fall to below 0.15, a historic low, as earnings expectations double while its valuation declines.

Wall Street also shows hesitation. Among the 59 Apple analysts tracked by Bloomberg, only 36 rate the stock as a buy; the share price has already surpassed analysts’ average target price, making Apple the only one of the seven big tech stocks whose implied 12‑month return, based on average target, is negative.

YieldMax ETFs strategist Mike Khouw cautions that Apple’s volatility is currently low, but its valuation is clearly elevated relative to history, leaving limited room for further expansion and raising the risk that part of the valuation premium could erode.

Dan Niles, founder of Niles Investment Management, still lists Apple as one of his top five picks for the year, arguing that if AI continues to develop, Apple can benefit through its phones and computers, and if AI sentiment reverses, the stock offers relative defensiveness. However, even though he likes Apple’s positioning in the current environment, he admits he does not like the present valuation.

items.title: 科技股預估本益比一年暴跌42%！Truist投資長喊進：市場悲觀情緒反成反彈訊號
items.title_en: Tech Stocks Forecast Forward P/E Plummets 42% in a Year! Truist CIO Calls It a Buying Opportunity as Market Pessimism Turns Into a Rebound Signal
paras: 在科技股估值經歷歷史性下修，投資人情緒也大幅惡化之後，Truist Advisory Services投資長Keith Lerner建議，目前科技股配置低於基準的投資人，可以開始考慮提高持股比重。
Lerner坦言，人工智慧(AI)交易仍面臨風險，尤其是輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳遭撤換，加深市場對領導層、晶片出口限制、融資環境、供需狀況，以及資料中心投資前景的疑慮。
但Lerner說：「市場不會等到不確定性完全消失才採取行動。市場往往在實際結果僅僅沒有預期中那麼糟時，就開始反轉。」
科技股占比高的那斯達克100指數已落入修正區間，周二(17日)收盤和10月6日高點相比回跌14%，將近三分之二成分股更進入熊市區間。
Lerner進一步指出，過去六個月以來，科技股相對標普500指數的表現已從9月底領先25%，轉為落後6%。
根據美國銀行(BofA)調查，全球AI熱潮的投資樂觀情緒正在消退，基金經理人對科技股的配置降幅創20年來最大。
Lerner認為，科技股表現落後、投資人情緒轉趨悲觀，反而是市場即將反彈的訊號，而非預告跌勢將進一步擴大。他指出，科技股預估本益比(forward P/E)過去12個月已下跌42%，是近30年來該產業最劇烈的估值修正之一。
儘管這波跌勢可能讓人聯想到網路泡沫，但Lerner說：「如今市場的起始條件與整體背景已大不相同。2000年市場觸頂前一年，科技股估值上漲逾100%。如今，科技股估值已跌破2022年底這波多頭行情啟動時的水準。」
當然，科技股投資並非毫無風險。Lerner指出，企業財報表現不如預期、利率走高，以及AI投資周期出現更大幅度的退潮，是他對市場展望最主要的威脅。
不過，此次估值修正「異常劇烈」，意味著只要企業獲利預估下修幅度沒有市場擔憂得那麼大，科技股就可能迅速反彈。
Lerner寫道：「雜誌封面往往被視為反向指標，因為當一個故事登上頭版時，相關論述通常已廣為人知，也可以說早已反映在市場價格中。恐懼與貪婪可能迅速轉變，市場也是如此。」
paras_en: After tech stock valuations underwent a historic downgrade and investor sentiment sharply deteriorated, Keith Lerner, CIO of Truist Advisory Services, suggested that investors whose tech allocation is below the benchmark can now start considering increasing their holdings.

Lerner admitted that AI trading still faces risks, especially after Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang was ousted, deepening market concerns about leadership, chip export restrictions, financing conditions, supply‑demand dynamics, and the outlook for data‑center investments.
But Lerner said, "The market won’t wait for all uncertainty to disappear before acting. It often turns around as soon as the actual outcome is not as bad as expected."

The Nasdaq‑100, which has a high weighting of tech stocks, has slipped into correction territory, closing on Tuesday the 17th down 14% from its October 6 peak, with nearly two‑thirds of its components now in bear‑market territory.
Lerner further noted that over the past six months the relative performance of tech stocks versus the S&P 500 has shifted from leading by 25% at the end of September to lagging by 6%.
According to a Bank of America survey, the global AI hype’s investment optimism is waning, and fund managers have cut their tech stock allocations by the biggest margin in 20 years.

Lerner believes that the lagging performance of tech stocks and the turn toward pessimistic sentiment actually signal an imminent market rebound rather than a further decline. He pointed out that the forward P/E for tech stocks has fallen 42% over the past 12 months, one of the steepest valuation corrections in the industry in the last 30 years.

Although this decline may evoke memories of the dot‑com bubble, Lerner said, "The market’s starting conditions and overall backdrop are vastly different today. A year before the 2000 peak, tech valuations rose more than 100%. Now, tech valuations have fallen below the level at the start of the bullish run at the end of 2022."

Of course, investing in tech stocks is not without risk. Lerner highlighted that weaker-than‑expected earnings, rising interest rates, and a deeper pull‑back in the AI investment cycle are the main threats to his market outlook.
However, this "exceptionally sharp" valuation correction means that as long as earnings revisions are not as severe as market fears suggest, tech stocks could rebound quickly.

Lerner wrote, "Magazine covers are often seen as contrarian indicators, because when a story makes the front page, the narrative is already widely known and essentially priced in. Fear and greed can flip rapidly, and the market is no different."

items.title: SpaceX假設對OpenAI「零銷售」！馬斯克反擊奧特曼AI晶片需求遭高估言論
items.title_en: SpaceX Assumes Zero Sales to OpenAI! Musk Counters Altman's Claim That AI Chip Demand Is Overestimated
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US)執行長馬斯克透露，公司目前假設對OpenAI的銷售額為零。馬斯克發表這番言論前，OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）才針對半導體產業可能高估需求一事，進一步說明先前的看法。馬斯克與奧特曼長期以來對OpenAI的本質與發展方向存在分歧。
根據《Wccftech》報導，奧特曼日前表示，資料中心的需求與建置規模可能存在上限，未必能消化供應鏈中所有即將到貨的晶片庫存。對此，馬斯克則在社群平台X發文反擊。
稍早，奧特曼在Semafor舉辦的一場活動中，談及自己向三星(005930KS) 主管表示AI晶片需求可能遭到高估的相關言論。
AI晶片需求是目前AI產業建設熱潮的核心議題，奧特曼先前也曾討論新興雲端業者（neocloud）在需求估算中扮演的角色。
奧特曼當時向三星主管表示，市場趨勢顯示，每家新興雲端業者在估算需求時，都可能將OpenAI與Anthropic的需求納入考量，導致整體晶片需求被高估，因為這兩家大型軟體公司可能只會使用部分新興雲端業者的基礎設施。
在此基礎上，奧特曼16日進一步表示：「我認為，需求以及資料中心的建置趨勢都相當穩健。但我們並不需要、也不可能，向每一家晶片供應商採購所有的供應量。」
然而，同時掌舵SpaceX與特斯拉(TSLA-US) 的馬斯克認為，如果OpenAI的產品表現無法帶動資料中心算力需求快速成長，那麼該公司就應該檢視自身產品是否出了問題。
馬斯克寫道：「SpaceX假設對OpenAI的銷售額為零。如果OpenAI的需求沒有快速攀升，那麼他們的產品一定出了問題。」
SpaceX今年稍早在首次公開募股（IPO）相關文件中揭露，公司已成為運算基礎設施供應商，業務涵蓋地面資料中心園區，以及未來透過衛星星座在太空提供運算服務的計畫。
SpaceX之所以躋身業界最大型運算服務供應商之列，部分仰賴旗下Colossus資料中心等設施。這些資料中心已與Google(GOOGL-US) 及Anthropic達成協議，將提供運算能力。
分析指出，從馬斯克的說法來看，他相信SpaceX即使不依賴OpenAI，也能充分運用自身所有的晶片運算產能。
此外，馬斯克同樣不看好新興雲端業者，先前曾預測這類業者將面臨「孔雀魚級別的大規模死亡」（guppy-level death）。
與此同時，馬斯克旗下Colossus資料中心計畫在2026年底前，讓超過120萬顆輝達(NVDA-US) GPU投入運作，目標是打造全球規模最大的運算叢集。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk disclosed that the company currently assumes zero sales to OpenAI. Musk made this remark after OpenAI CEO Sam Altman addressed the possibility that the semiconductor industry may have overestimated demand, further explaining his earlier view. Musk and Altman have long disagreed on OpenAI's nature and development direction.

According to a report by Wccftech, Altman recently said that data‑center demand and build‑out scale may have an upper limit and might not be able to absorb all the chip inventory soon arriving in the supply chain. Musk responded to this on the social platform X.
Earlier, Altman at a Semafor‑hosted event mentioned his comments to a Samsung (005930KS) executive that AI‑chip demand could be overestimated.
AI‑chip demand is a core issue in the current AI industry construction boom, and Altman has previously discussed the role of emerging cloud providers (neocloud) in demand estimates.

Altman told the Samsung executive that market trends show each emerging cloud provider may factor OpenAI and Anthropic demand into its estimates, inflating overall chip demand because these two large software firms may only use a portion of the emerging clouds' infrastructure.
Building on that, Altman said on the 16th: "I think demand and data‑center build‑out trends are quite robust. But we don’t need, nor can we, purchase the entire supply from every chip supplier."

However, Elon Musk, who also runs Tesla (TSLA-US), believes that if OpenAI’s products fail to drive rapid growth in data‑center compute demand, the company should examine whether its products have problems.
Musk wrote: "SpaceX assumes zero sales to OpenAI. If OpenAI’s demand doesn’t surge quickly, then their product must be flawed."

Earlier this year, SpaceX disclosed in its IPO filing that it has become a provider of compute infrastructure, covering ground data‑center campuses and plans to offer compute services from a satellite constellation in space.

SpaceX’s rise to become one of the industry’s largest compute service providers is partly due to facilities such as its Colossus data centers, which have agreements with Google (GOOGL-US) and Anthropic to supply compute power.
Analysts note that from Musk’s comments, he believes SpaceX can fully utilize all its chip compute capacity even without relying on OpenAI.
Musk also remains skeptical of emerging cloud providers, having previously predicted they would face a "guppy‑level mass death."
Meanwhile, Musk’s Colossus data‑center project aims to have over 1.2 million NVIDIA (NVDA-US) GPUs operational by the end of 2026, targeting the creation of the world’s largest compute cluster.

paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar today (18th) under continued pressure from foreign investors selling stocks and repatriating funds once again fell below the 33 NTD whole‑number mark; in the half hour before market close the depreciation eased, ending at 32.947 NTD, down 9.7 cents. Among major Asian currencies, the Korean won rebounded more than 0.4%, the Japanese yen appreciated nearly 0.1%, the Chinese yuan hovered flat with narrow fluctuations, the Singapore dollar slipped about 0.1%, and the NT$ fell 0.3%; the US dollar index rose over 0.2%.

Second, inflation and rate‑hike pressure: with Fed officials continuing hawkish rhetoric, Yuanta Securities believes the probability of a December rate hike is approaching 90%, keeping the US 10‑year Treasury yield above 5%.

items.title: 美股牛市還能跑多久？高盛：2027年再漲17% 標普上看8700點 但最強獲利成長階段已過
items.title_en: How Long Can the US Bull Market Run? Goldman Sachs: 17% Rise by 2027, S&P 500 Target 8,700 Points
paras: 高盛最新預測，美股牛市將延續至2027年，但回報率將較前幾年降溫，標普500指數明年底有望上看8700點，較目前水準上漲約17%，低於過去四年21%的年化報酬率。
高盛美股策略首席分析師Ben Snider在最新研究報告中表示，企業獲利成長仍是股市主要支撐，但隨著AI相關資本支出逐漸放緩，獲利增速也將回落。
Snider在報告中指出，標普成分股企業獲利增速將從2026年的30%降至2027年的18%，並可能持續放緩至2028年。「我們預估，隨著企業獲利成長放緩，2027年股票回報率也將有所回落。」
儘管如此，高盛認為目前美股估值仍屬合理。標普今年來持續刷新歷史高點，企業獲利快速成長使本益比倍數下降，目前指數預期本益比約18倍，待第三季財報全數公布後，標普500成分股企業可望連三季實現超過25%的獲利增長。
不過，2027年市場仍面臨兩大壓力：利率可能進一步走升，以及AI投資前景的不確定性，兩者皆可能限制股價上行空間。
Snider指出，企業獲利前景是2027年美股展望的最大變數。在悲觀情境下，若標普獲利預期回落至過去30年趨勢水準，同時本益比降至30年平均17倍，可能下跌約23%至5600點附近。反之，若AI資本支出週期比預期更強勁，或生產率成長超乎預期，推動獲利前景進一步改善，標普到2027年底可望上漲近30%至9400點。AI投資的持續性與實際回報，將決定下一階段美股表現。
產業配置上，高盛預估超大規模雲端企業將繼續受惠AI投資週期，長期大規模回購股票的「回購貴族」也有望表現突出。
值得注意的是，能源基礎設施供應商可能成為2027年獲利增長加速最明顯的群體之一，隨著AI相關基建持續推進，這類企業獲利前景可望改善。
此外，高盛建議關注醫療保健與必需消費品行業，這些類股能提供不同於科技股的配置選擇，在市場波動加劇時發揮分散風險的作用。
根據高盛判斷，2027年美股仍有望延續牛市，但驅動力將從AI資本開支帶動的高速增長，轉向更廣泛的企業獲利改善。對投資人而言，AI熱潮能否真正轉化為生產率提升與利潤增長，將決定標普最終趨近8700點的基準目標，或是向9400點的樂觀情境邁進。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs’ latest forecast suggests the US bull market will continue until 2027, but returns will cool off compared to previous years. The S&P 500 is expected to reach about 8,700 points by the end of next year, a rise of roughly 17% from current levels, below the 21% annualized return of the past four years.

Goldman Sachs’ U.S. equity strategy chief analyst Ben Snider said in a new research report that corporate earnings growth remains the main support for the market, but as AI‑related capital spending slows, earnings growth will also decline.

Snider noted that earnings growth for S&P component companies is projected to fall from 30% in 2026 to 18% in 2027, and may continue to slow into 2028. ‘We expect that as corporate earnings growth slows, the 2027 stock return rate will also decline,’ he said.

Despite this, Goldman Sachs believes current U.S. equity valuations remain reasonable. The S&P has been breaking historical highs this year, and rapid earnings growth has lowered the price‑to‑earnings multiple to about 18×. After the full Q3 earnings are released, S&P component companies could achieve more than 25% earnings growth for three consecutive quarters.
However, the market will still face two major pressures in 2027: rates could rise further, and the uncertainty around AI investment prospects could limit upside potential.

Snider pointed out that corporate earnings prospects are the biggest variable for the 2027 U.S. equity outlook. In a pessimistic scenario, if S&P earnings expectations fall to the 30‑year trend level and the P/E ratio drops to the 30‑year average of 17×, the index could fall about 23% to around 5,600 points. Conversely, if AI capital spending cycles are stronger than expected or productivity growth exceeds expectations, pushing earnings prospects further, the S&P could rise nearly 30% to 9,400 points by the end of 2027. The sustainability and actual return of AI investment will determine the next phase of U.S. equity performance.

In terms of sector allocation, Goldman Sachs expects ultra‑large cloud companies to continue benefiting from the AI investment cycle, and long‑term large‑scale share‑repurchase “buy‑back aristocrats” are also likely to perform strongly.

Notably, energy infrastructure suppliers could become one of the most obvious groups to accelerate earnings growth in 2027, as AI‑related infrastructure continues to advance and improve the earnings outlook for these firms.

Additionally, Goldman Sachs recommends paying attention to healthcare and consumer staples, as these sectors offer a different allocation choice from tech stocks and can provide risk diversification when market volatility intensifies.

According to Goldman Sachs’ assessment, the U.S. equity market can still continue its bull run in 2027, but the driving force will shift from high‑growth AI capital spending to broader corporate earnings improvement. For investors, whether the AI boom can truly translate into productivity gains and profit growth will determine whether the S&P ultimately approaches the 8,700‑point target or moves toward the optimistic 9,400‑point scenario.

items.title: 〈台幣〉33元上下拋補激烈拉扯 國家隊蹲馬步穩台股匯市
items.title_en: Around NT$33, Fierce Toss‑and‑Catch; National Team Holds Steady to Stabilize Taiwan Stocks and FX
paras: 在外資龐大的出走潮下，台北股匯市今(18)日續弱，不僅加權指數又跌破4萬點關卡，最低來到39260點，跌點超過800點，新台幣也再度見貶破33元心理大關，不過，國家隊蹲馬步有效穩盤，台股盤中又翻紅，市場密切關注33元台幣價位是否為中央銀行的容忍底線。
新台幣今日以32.83元、升值2分開出後，隨即轉弱，盤中越最越低，截至11點15分最低來到33.002元，貶幅超過0.45%，是盤中最弱的主要亞幣。
反觀韓元升值達0.4%，人民幣、日元和星元小貶0.05%上下，美元指數則反彈0.1%左右。
法人分析，國安基金於4萬點伺機進場，觀察4萬點是否形成利空測試的第二隻腳，短線上台股將在AI大環境不確定下反覆利空測試，而今日適逢台指期結算，須提防外資壓低結算，並觀察轉倉後部位變化。
paras_en: Amid a massive outflow of foreign capital, Taipei's stock and foreign exchange markets continued to weaken today (the 18th), with the weighted index falling below the 40,000‑point threshold again, dropping to a low of 39,260 points, a decline of more than 800 points. The New Taiwan dollar also slipped past the psychological NT$33 barrier again. However, the “national team” took a defensive stance and effectively steadied the market, and the Taiwan stock market turned red again during trading. The market is closely watching whether the NT$33 level is the central bank’s tolerance floor.

The New Taiwan dollar opened today at NT$32.83, up 0.02, but immediately weakened, sinking lower throughout the session. By 11:15 a.m., it fell to a low of NT$33.002, a depreciation of over 0.45%, making it the weakest major Asian currency intraday.
By contrast, the Korean won appreciated about 0.4%, while the Chinese yuan, Japanese yen and Singapore dollar each slipped roughly 0.05%, and the U.S. dollar index rebounded about 0.1%.

Corporate analysts say the National Security Fund is waiting to enter around the 40,000‑point level, watching whether a second leg of a negative test forms at that point. In the short term, Taiwan stocks will undergo repeated negative tests amid uncertainty in the AI macro environment. Today also coincides with the settlement of Taiwan index futures, so caution is needed against foreign investors pushing prices down for settlement, and positions after the roll‑over should be monitored.

items.title_en: <NY Forex> Dollar Falls Yet Still Near 2025‑April High as US Economic Data Shows Mixed Signals
paras: 美元週二(17日) 自近期高點回落，但仍接近 2025 年 4 月以來最強水準，美國公布的經濟數據喜憂參半，顯示消費支出維持穩定，但房市景氣轉弱。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌 0.1%，報 103.44。過去五個交易日累計上漲近 2%，美元指數近期受到通膨數據偏熱及聯準會(Fed)官員鷹派談話支撐。
不過，策略師認為，美元此次回落只是近期強勢反彈後的短暫停頓，而非更大幅度回檔的開始。
Corpay 首席市場策略師 Karl Schamotta 表示，「自上週聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller) 轉向鷹派立場，加上美國通膨加速升溫，推高市場利率預期並擴大各貨幣之間的利差以來，美元相較於所有主要貨幣對手幾乎一路占上風。」
週二公布的數據顯示，美國 10 月零售銷售溫和成長，但在物價上漲之際，家庭減少購買汽車及其他高單價商品。
另一項週二公布的調查顯示，11 月美國住宅建商信心大幅下滑，降至逾 14 年半以來低點。房貸利率上升使潛在買家暫緩購屋，加上移民政策收緊導致勞工短缺，進一步推高建商成本。
投資人仍深信，聯準會為了抑制通膨，將於 12 月升息。芝商所(CME)FedWatch 工具顯示，交易員預期聯準會 12 月將升息 1 碼。
Brown Brothers Harriman 外匯團隊全球市場策略主管 Elias Haddad 在報告中表示，「隨著其他主要央行收緊貨幣政策，與聯準會之間的政策分歧縮小，美元近期漲勢可能已經過度。」
Haddad 進一步指出，「儘管如此，美國經濟成長穩健、勞動市場狀況良好，加上核心通膨居高不下，仍使美元整體走勢偏向看漲。」
科技股動向
近期 AI 與科技股遭遇拋售，市場受到多項因素衝擊，包括輝達(NVDA-US)執行長突然離職、美國期中選舉由民主黨大勝，以及市場擔憂以債務融資推動的 AI 基礎設施擴張可能帶來風險，投資人的風險偏好因此受到打擊，市場氣氛轉趨緊張。
接下來，輝達的財報及 Anthropic 預計週四登場的市場首秀，將成為檢驗市場對 AI 投資情緒的重要關鍵。
對風險較敏感的貨幣，包括澳幣與紐幣，過去六個交易日分別下跌 2.7% 與 2.3%。
若市場動盪進一步加劇，投資人可能轉向美元尋求避險，短期內有利美元走勢。然而，若 AI 投資題材遭遇更長時間的衝擊，這項長期主導美國市場的投資熱潮，也可能削弱市場對美元的需求。
Corpay 的 Schamotta 表示，「AI 投資題材一直是吸引外國資金流入美國資產的主要磁石之一。如果市場隨著時間推移逐漸降低對 AI 熱潮的預期，投資人就不會再問『我要躲到哪裡避險？』，而會開始思考『為什麼我的美國資產配置比重這麼高？』」
另一方面，歐元兌美元上漲 0.2%，至 1.10133 美元，稍早盤中一度跌至 1.0983 美元，創 19 個月新低。
Rabobank 外匯策略主管 Jane Foley 表示，市場可能先在 1.10 美元附近進入一段整理期，之後才會有足夠信心進一步推低歐元。
美元兌日元下跌 0.1%，至 159.30 日圓，距離 160 日元關卡僅一步之遙。交易員認為，160 日元可能是日本當局再次進場干預、支撐日元的觸發水準。
Foley 表示，「市場對干預措施抱持戒心，正是美元兌日元從 160 日元回落的原因之一。」她形容，160 日元是「極難突破」的關卡。
她補充指出，日本在 7 月與美國聯手干預匯市、支撐日元的行動，顯示日本政府捍衛本國貨幣的決心相當強烈。
英鎊兌美元上漲 0.3%，至 1.32215 美元，市場正等待週三公布的通膨數據。

paras_en: The dollar slipped from recent highs on Tuesday (the 17th) but remains close to its strongest level since April 2025, as US economic data released was mixed, showing stable consumer spending but a weakening housing market.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.1% to 103.44. Over the past five trading days it has risen almost 2%, with the index recently supported by hotter‑than‑expected inflation data and hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials.
However, strategists say the dollar’s pullback is only a brief pause after a recent strong rebound, not the start of a larger correction.

Corpay chief market strategist Karl Schamotta said, “Since Fed Governor Christopher Waller turned hawkish last week and US inflation accelerated, pushing up market rate expectations and widening currency differentials, the dollar has been dominant against virtually all major peers.”
Data released on Tuesday showed US retail sales for October grew modestly, but as prices rose households cut back on buying cars and other high‑priced items.

Another survey released on Tuesday indicated US home‑builder confidence plunged sharply in November, falling to its lowest level in more than 14‑and‑a‑half years. Rising mortgage rates have delayed prospective buyers, and tighter immigration policy has created labor shortages that further raise builders’ costs.
Investors remain convinced the Fed will raise rates in December to curb inflation. CME’s FedWatch tool shows traders expect a one‑point rate hike at the December meeting.

Brown Brothers Harriman’s global markets FX chief Elias Haddad wrote, “With other major central banks tightening and the policy gap with the Fed narrowing, the dollar’s recent rally may already be over‑done.”
Haddad added, “Nevertheless, solid US economic growth, a strong labour market and persistently high core inflation keep the dollar’s overall outlook bullish.”
Tech‑stock moves

Recent AI and tech stocks have faced sell‑offs, hit by several factors including Nvidia’s (NVDA‑US) CEO’s sudden departure, a Democratic landslide in the US mid‑term elections, and market worries that debt‑financed AI infrastructure expansion could pose risks, dampening investors’ risk appetite and tightening market sentiment.
Going forward, Nvidia’s earnings and Anthropic’s market debut slated for Thursday will be key gauges of sentiment toward AI investments.
Risk‑sensitive currencies such as the Australian and New Zealand dollars have each fallen over the past six trading days, down 2.7% and 2.3% respectively.

If market turbulence intensifies, investors may flee to the dollar for safety, supporting it in the short term. Yet if the AI theme suffers a prolonged hit, the long‑standing driver of US market inflows could also reduce demand for the greenback.

Schamotta of Corpay said, “AI has been one of the main magnets pulling foreign capital into US assets. If the market’s enthusiasm for AI wanes over time, investors will stop asking ‘Where should I hedge?’ and start questioning ‘Why is my US asset allocation so high?’”
On the other side, the euro rose 0.2% against the dollar to $1.10133, after briefly slipping to $1.0983 earlier in the session, a 19‑month low.
Rabobank FX strategy head Jane Foley said the market may first consolidate around $1.10 before gaining enough confidence to push the euro lower.
The dollar fell 0.1% against the yen to ¥159.30, just a step away from the ¥160 barrier. Traders think ¥160 could trigger another intervention by Japanese authorities to support the yen.
Foley noted, “Caution about possible intervention is one reason the dollar‑yen pair has retreated from ¥160,” describing ¥160 as a “very hard‑to‑break” level.

items.title: 從市場助力到「破壞球」：美元走強為何讓華爾街感到不安？
items.title_en: From Market Support to a ‘Disruptive Force’: Why a Stronger Dollar Is Making Wall Street Uneasy
paras: 美元指數在周二（17日）亞洲交易時段小幅回調0.1%，但周一來到103.7，創19個月新高，華爾街策略師開始擔憂若美元漲勢過快，原本支撐美國資產的強勢美元，反而可能成為加劇美股動盪的「破壞性力量」。
《MarketWatch》報導，美元正重新成為全球金融市場的重要變量。美國經濟表現強於其他主要經濟體、AI基礎設施投資持續吸引海外資金，加上Fed可能進一步升息，推動美元近期加速走強。
美銀全球研究部投資策略師Michael Hartnett上周警告，若美元持續飆升，將成為全球金融市場的「破壞球」，對風險資產構成嚴重威脅。專家指出，美國經濟相對強勁、利率預期偏高，加上AI投資熱潮吸引海外資金，正推升美元走勢。
分析認為，美元升值通常伴隨融資成本上升與金融條件緊縮，對全球股市、債市等風險資產形成普遍壓力。
歷史數據顯示，多數資產與美元呈負相關，僅原油及能源股例外。此外，美元走強將加重以美元借貸的海外企業償債負擔，並可能使國際資金回流美國，進一步壓抑非美市場表現。
在AI浪潮方面，高盛策略師發現，美元漲勢與AI相關股票表現密切連動，無論市場涨跌皆然。AI企業股價走強吸引海外資金湧入，形成「AI股漲—美元升」的正向循環。
高盛預估，美元升值態勢可能延續至2027年，但速度將放緩。不過，若資料中心建設因故減速，AI動能減弱，美元升勢也將面臨回落風險。
Fed後續利率決策仍是關鍵變數。市場預期Fed可能繼續升息，支撐美元偏強格局。
Sevens Report Research創辦人Tom Essaye指出，短期美股或許尚能承受，但若美元指數升至105或更高水平，將開始對標普500等主要指數造成實質衝擊，投資人須嚴防美元過熱引發的金融動盪。
paras_en: The dollar index slipped 0.1% during Asian trading on Tuesday (the 17th), but on Monday it rose to 103.7, a 19‑month high, prompting Wall Street strategists to worry that if the dollar’s rise accelerates, the strong dollar that has been supporting U.S. assets could instead become a “disruptive force” that fuels volatility in U.S. equities.

MarketWatch reports that the dollar is re‑emerging as a key variable in global financial markets. A U.S. economy that is performing better than other major economies, continued overseas inflows into AI infrastructure investments, and the prospect of further Fed rate hikes are all driving the dollar’s recent acceleration.

Bank of America Global Research investment strategist Michael Hartnett warned last week that a persistently soaring dollar would become a “disruptive ball” for global financial markets, posing a serious threat to risk assets. Experts note that a relatively strong U.S. economy, higher‑than‑expected rate expectations, and the AI investment boom attracting foreign capital are all pushing the dollar higher.
Analysts say that dollar appreciation usually comes with higher financing costs and tighter financial conditions, creating broad pressure on global equities, bonds and other risk assets.

Historical data show that most assets have a negative correlation with the dollar, with oil and energy stocks as the only exceptions. A stronger dollar also raises the debt‑servicing burden for overseas companies that borrow in dollars and could trigger a repatriation of international capital to the United States, further dampening performance in non‑U.S. markets.

On the AI front, Goldman Sachs strategists have found that the dollar’s rise is closely linked to the performance of AI‑related stocks, regardless of overall market direction. Strong AI stock gains attract foreign capital, creating a positive feedback loop of “AI stock rally → dollar rise.”

Goldman Sachs projects that the dollar’s appreciation could continue through 2027, albeit at a slower pace. However, if data‑center construction slows for any reason and AI momentum weakens, the dollar’s upward trajectory could face a pull‑back risk.
Future Fed rate decisions remain a key variable. Markets expect the Fed may keep raising rates, supporting a relatively strong dollar environment.

Tom Essaye, founder of Sevens Report Research, notes that U.S. equities may still hold up in the short term, but if the dollar index climbs to 105 or higher, it will begin to deliver material blows to major indices such as the S&P 500, and investors need to guard against financial turbulence sparked by an overheated dollar.

items.title: 47層金色高塔成形！川普圖書館頭七月募5760萬美元 金主來源不透明  ABC、Meta和解金藏多少？
items.title_en: Golden 47‑Story Tower Takes Shape! Trump Library Raises $57.6 Million in First Seven Months, Funding Sources Opaque, How Much of ABC, Meta Settlement Money Is Hidden?
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美國總統川普籌建總統圖書館的基金會，成立前七個月累計募得5760萬美元，超出原先預期，但資金來源缺乏透明度，未披露捐贈者身份，也無法確認巨額訴訟和解款的實際到帳規模，工程建設用地也面臨法律爭議。
根據《華盛頓郵報》與《CNN》周一(16日)報導，去年稅務申報文件顯示，基金會截至去年底籌得5760萬美元，為川普打算在邁阿密市中心興建的47層樓圖書館提供初步資金。該建築入口採金色裝飾，擬展示一架空軍一號飛機且可能兼具飯店功能。文件中未公開捐贈者名單，也未說明《ABC》、Meta、派拉蒙等企業支付的訴訟和解金在籌款總額中佔比。
基金會原向美國國稅局(IRS)預估2025年底籌資約5000萬美元，實際金額高出760萬美元。基金會曾預估2027年底累計籌資近10億美元，但最新文件未提籌款目標能否實現的資訊。
支出方面，基金會成立前七個月僅花費約34.9萬美元，大部分支付給建築設計公司Bermello Ajamil & Partners，用於製作效果圖。
基金會由五人董事會管理，包括川普次子艾利克、女婿麥可·布洛斯及律師詹姆斯·凱利。文件顯示，去年管理人員及受托人均未支薪。
資金來源受關注的關鍵在於和解安排。2024年大選期間及川普第一任期結束後，他對多家媒體與科技企業提告，部分企業以和解收場並同意撥款。ABC於2024年12月同意支付1500萬美元；Meta於2025年1月指定2200萬美元；《CBS》母公司派拉蒙達成總額1600萬美元和解，扣除費用後餘款轉交，三項和解金合計5300萬美元，但文件未列各筆到帳金額，故無法確認5760萬中有多少直接來自這些和解金。
此外，佛州州長德桑提斯去年協助推動，將邁阿密市中心一塊原屬邁阿密戴德學院、估值約6300萬美元的土地轉交基金會。不過多名南佛州居民已提告阻止，並將川普、基金會、佛州政府及學院列為被告。川普等已請求聯邦法官駁回，爭議未決。
初期籌款雖超預期，基金會距2027年底近10億美元目標仍差距甚遠。在捐款名單與和解金流向未公開下，這座「金色圖書館」的資金透明度與潛在利益衝突疑雲，將持續受公眾檢視。
paras_en: Foreign media reports say the foundation set up to build former President Trump’s presidential library raised $57.6 million in its first seven months, exceeding expectations but lacking transparency about donors and the actual amount of large litigation settlement funds that have been received, while the construction site also faces legal disputes.

According to the Washington Post and CNN on Monday (the 16th), tax filings from last year show the foundation had raised $57.6 million by year‑end, providing seed money for the planned 47‑story library in downtown Miami. The building’s entrance will be gilded, it is slated to display a Air Force One aircraft and may also include a hotel component. The filings do not disclose the list of donors nor explain what share of the total comes from settlement payments by companies such as ABC, Meta and Paramount.

The foundation had originally projected to the IRS that it would raise about $50 million by the end of 2025; the actual amount was $7.6 million higher. It had also forecast nearly $1 billion in cumulative fundraising by the end of 2027, but the latest documents contain no information on whether that target is still realistic.
On the expense side, the foundation spent only about $349,000 in its first seven months, most of which went to the architectural firm Bermello Ajamil & Partners for rendering work.

The foundation is overseen by a five‑member board that includes Trump’s son Eric, son‑in‑law Michael Boulos and lawyer James Kelly. The filings show that none of the managers or trustees received a salary last year.

The source of the money is under scrutiny because of settlement arrangements. During the 2024 election cycle and after Trump left office, he sued several media and tech firms, some of which settled and agreed to fund the foundation. ABC agreed in December 2024 to pay $15 million; Meta earmarked $22 million in January 2025; CBS parent Paramount reached a settlement totaling $16 million, with the balance after fees transferred to the foundation. The three settlements total $53 million, but the filings do not list the amounts actually received, so it is unclear how much of the $57.6 million comes directly from those settlements.

In addition, Florida Governor Ron DeSantis helped last year to transfer a parcel of land in downtown Miami, formerly owned by Miami‑Dade College and valued at about $63 million, to the foundation. Several South‑Florida residents have sued to block the transfer, naming Trump, the foundation, the state government and the college as defendants. Trump and co‑defendants have asked a federal judge to dismiss the case, and the dispute remains unresolved.

Although early fundraising exceeded expectations, the foundation is still far from its near‑$1 billion goal for the end of 2027. With donor lists and settlement flows undisclosed, the financial transparency and potential conflicts of interest surrounding the “golden library” will continue to draw public scrutiny.

items.title: 〈台幣〉又驚見33元 央行阻貶？收盤前轉升收32.85元
items.title_en: NTD Again Threatens 33: Central Bank Halts Decline? Rises to 32.85 Before Close
paras: 美股動盪令外資持續出走，造成今(17)日台股又見大逃殺壓力，在國安基金護盤下終場驚險守住4萬點心理大關，而台北匯市也見到中央銀行出手調節維持動態穩定，雖一度貶破33元大關，收盤前半小時轉升值，終場收在32.85元，升值3.6分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值衝上28.24億美元，可見拋補雙方的拉距戰相當激烈。
新台幣今日以32.89元、貶值0.4分開出後，隨著台股上下大幅震盪，最低一度貶至33.015元，不過，在央行強調實戰穩盤的態度下，收盤前意外轉升，收在全日最高點，高低價差達1.65角。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元震盪幅度大但目前貶幅僅0.1%左右，美元指數處平盤附近，星元和人民幣小升不到0.05%，新台幣收升0.11%，日元彈升0.15%左右，泰銖也彈約0.2%上下。
法人認為，黃仁勳下台市場又傳出輝達新伺服器 Rubin 延後放量，整體AI 產業疑慮待釐清，造成內資的融資籌碼也湧出停損，雖今日多頭軍有效守4萬點關卡上，但盤勢續挫，瀰漫偏悲觀的氣氛，首場沒有黃仁勳的輝達法說會將登場，市場如何回應須密切關注。
paras_en: U.S. equity turbulence continued to drive foreign investors out, putting the Taiwan market under a fresh wave of sell‑off pressure on the 17th. With the National Security Fund stepping in to support, the market narrowly held the psychological 40,000‑point barrier. In the Taipei foreign‑exchange market, the central bank intervened to maintain dynamic stability; the New Taiwan dollar briefly slipped past the 33‑per‑U.S.‑dollar mark but recovered in the last half‑hour, closing at 32.85, a gain of 0.036. Transaction volume at Taipei FX brokers surged to $2.824 billion, indicating a fierce tug‑of‑war between buyers and sellers.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.89, down 0.004, and as the Taiwan stock index swung wildly it fell as low as 33.015. However, under the central bank’s firm stance on stabilizing the market, the currency unexpectedly rose before the close, ending at the day's high with a spread of 0.165 between the high and low.

Among major Asian currencies, the Korean won showed the largest volatility but was down only about 0.1%. The U.S. Dollar Index hovered near flat. The Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan each edged up less than 0.05%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.11%, the Japanese yen jumped roughly 0.15%, and the Thai baht rebounded about 0.2%.

Institutional investors note that after Jensen Huang’s departure, rumors surfaced that Nvidia’s new Rubin server rollout would be delayed, leaving doubts over the broader AI sector. This prompted domestic leveraged positions to unwind. Although bullish forces managed to keep the market above the 40,000‑point line today, the overall trend remained weak, fostering a pessimistic atmosphere. Nvidia’s first earnings call without Huang is set to take place, and market reaction will need close monitoring.
